moves.notes: Strong neutral buffer tool; active frames 1-2 have shorter range (this close-range hitbox disappears after the 3rd active frame, making it less useful as a meaty); active frames 3-5 gain a longer range foot hitbox, but cannot hit crouching opponents and cannot hit cross-up; these later active frames result in 2f better frame advantage; the final 2 TC cancel frames do not combo without at least a Counter-hit starter; lenient hitconfirm window gives time to confirm a Super, or a TC follow-up if the opponent is standing; forces stand on Punish Counter, ensuring the TC will fully connect

moves.name: 5HP 5H
moves.notes: Forces stand; foot hitbox cannot hit crouching opponents (shorter range vs. crouching); Punish Counter puts opponent into limited juggle state; strong anti-air hitbox at longer ranges but cannot hit cross-up; extends hurtbox 1f before active that is vulnerable to projectiles

moves.name: 5LK 5L
moves.notes: Ranged light poke that gives Elena strong punishes and confirms; allows for 4-light confirm strings after chained 2LPs, but does not combo naturally into 214LK; Special/DI cancel is delayed until after 2nd active frame; DR cancel is delayed until after 3rd active frame

moves.name: 5MK A[H]
moves.notes: 2f extra recovery on whiff; useful combo and frame trap tool; short range for a 6-frame medium

moves.name: 5HK -
moves.notes: Low Crush 9-17f (not airborne); good mid-range poke; Punish Counter puts opponent into limited juggle state (combos reliably into 236KK or SA2 unless whiff punishing a ranged attack); also causes limited juggle state on airborne Counter-hit (into 623HK at close range) and Punish Counter (slightly better juggles than grounded PC); extends hurtbox 1f before active that is vulnerable to projectiles; hitbox does not move forward during the active frames (cannot be spaced in neutral for better advantage)

moves.name: 2LP 2L
moves.notes: Chains into 2LP/2LK; topmost hurtbox on frames 1-6 is vulnerable only to aerial strikes (preventing its use as an anti-air); DR cancel is delayed until after 2nd active frame

moves.name: 2MP A[M]
moves.notes: Great cancelable poke in neutral; not an anti-air despite the animation; DR cancel is delayed until after active frames

moves.name: 2HP 2H
moves.notes: 2 hits; Upper Body/Legs are anti-air invuln on frames 8-19 (solid anti-air but cannot hit cross-up); forces stand (important for 236K combo routes); 1st hit causes air reset when uses as an anti-air (2nd hit continues to whiff, leaving Elena with very little frame advantage when the opponent lands); 2nd hit puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state (useful in DI or DR juggles where both hits connect); canceling anti-air 2HP into 236P sets up a juggle into the ~6MK follow-up if the opponent is juggled, or a safe meaty ~6LK if the opponent was air reset; cancel only comes out on the 2nd hit (will cancel on whiff if the first hit connects on airborne opponent); high pushback on hit; follow-up links require a Counter-hit, Punish Counter, Drive Rush starter into a ranged button; Counter-hit/Punish Counter bonus advantage carries through both hits; if 1st hit is Perfect Parried, opponent can interrupt 2nd hit with 5f or faster attack

moves.name: 2LK A[L]
moves.notes: Chains into 2LP/2LK

moves.name: 2MK 2M
moves.notes: 2f extra recovery on whiff/block; good combo starter out of Drive Rush that leaves Elena +1 on block slightly out of throw range; moves Elena forward and can combo naturally into 2LP

moves.name: 2HK 3H
moves.notes: Long range sweep; has juggle potential; punishable by most other sweeps even at max range

moves.name: j.LP j.L
moves.notes: Cross-up; can be used as a fuzzy instant overhead (except vs. Blanka); Target Combo extension can lead to better advantage vs. grounded opponents, giving more time to hitconfirm a follow-up

moves.name: j.MP j.M
moves.notes: Puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state; at most air-to-air timings, Elena's only follow-up juggle is a Target Combo extension; whiffs against standard-sized crouching opponents; lower body projectile invuln 8-17f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: j.HP j.A[H]
moves.notes: Elena's strongest overall jump-in (reaches downward faster than j.HK and deals all its damage in one hit); lower body projectile invuln 10-23f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: j.LK j.A[L]
moves.notes: Can be used as a fuzzy instant overhead; good downward hitbox priority (likely to beat or trade with anti-airs)

moves.name: j.MK j.A[M]
moves.notes: Cross-up with a wide hitbox in both directions; lower body projectile invuln 7-20f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: j.HK j.H
moves.notes: 2 hits; 1st hit puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state; 2nd hit causes spike knockdown vs. airborne opponents; 2nd hit has the most horizontal range of Elena's air normals; overall weaker as an air approach due to the damage being split between 2 hits (very specific timing required to land both hits vs. grounded opponents); if 1st hit is stand blocked, the 2nd hit will not hit overhead against crouch block; lower body projectile invuln 10-22f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: 6HP 6H
moves.notes: Forward-moving ranged poke that can be hitconfirmed into a TC knockdown follow-up; TC is always a true blockstring; pushback keeps Elena safe (except at close range vs. Marisa/E.Honda/Sagat 2LP and Zangief 2LK); pushback also prevents a follow-up link even with Drive Rush (+5), but can link 5LK after a corner Punish Counter

moves.name: 6MK 6M
moves.notes: Long-range overhead with fast startup and a hitconfirmable TC follow-up

moves.name: 4HK 4H
moves.notes: Low Crush 9-17f (not airborne); 2f extra recovery on whiff; Counter-hit/Punish Counter puts opponent into a limited juggle state (can chase with DR oki, 236LP~6LP~6LK pressure, or juggle 623MK/623KK if used point blank in the corner); Elena moves backward starting on frame 5 (can help avoid the opponent's attack or throw)

moves.name: 3HK -
moves.notes: 4f extra recovery on whiff or vs. armor; does not low profile under projectiles; reaches ~1/2 screen and is safe when spaced well

moves.name: 5MP~MP 5M~M
moves.notes: Whiffs on crouching opponents (but can force stand with Punish Counter 5MP); interruptible 6-8f gap between hits; does not combo from the final 2 cancelable frames of 5MP without at least a Counter-hit

moves.name: 5HP~HP 5H~H
moves.notes: Whiffs on crouch blocking opponents; puts opponents into limited juggle state with a much more rewarding juggle after Punish Counter 5HP; if 5HP is stand blocked, the first hit of the follow-up will also be stand blocked, but the last hit still whiffs leaving Elena unsafe; starter scaling only applies if the 2nd HP begins the combo (e.g. opponent tries to jump out after crouch blocking 5HP)

moves.name: 5MK~HK A[H~H]
moves.notes: Puts opponent into limited juggle state; Elena's main Target Combo conversion on crouching opponents; Special/DI/DR cancel is delayed until after 1st recovery frame

moves.name: 2MK~HK 2M~M
moves.notes: () refers to scaled damage from 2MK combo starter; whiffs on crouching opponents (-18 after 2MK on hit, -24 after 2MK on block); 4f extra recovery on whiff or parry; the HK itself usually cannot be blocked since a blocked 2MK forces the opponent to crouch under it, but the entire sequence can be parried (block data notated with * refers to this scenario); if the TC is delayed as late as possible, the opponent can block 2MK and then Parry the follow-up or get hit while trying to jump; Special/DI/DR cancel is delayed until after 1st recovery frame

moves.name: 6HP~HP 6H~H
moves.notes: Hitconfirmable extension from long-range 6HP; has no juggle potential (will not juggle after DI wall splat); always a true blockstring from 6HP

moves.name: 6HP~HP~HP 6H~H~H
moves.notes: () refers to scaled damage after a 6HP combo starter; good corner carry and knockdown advantage that can lead to auto-timed Lynx Whirl pressure on the opponent's wakeup; always a true blockstring from 6HP~HP

moves.name: 6MK~MK 6M~M
moves.notes: Hitconfirmable Target Combo that makes Elena's long-range overhead more threatening even without Drive Rush

moves.name: j.LP~j.MK j.L~L
moves.notes: Can hit after cross-up j.LP; can be done from any jump direction; does not work as an air-to-air even after a Forced Knockdown; will not connect if the j.LP hits a crouching opponent

moves.name: j.MP~j.HP j.M~M
moves.notes: Knockdown ender from air-to-air j.MP that puts opponent into a limited juggle state; can be done from any jump direction; cannot connect on a grounded opponent

moves.name: LPLK LM
moves.notes: Grants a frame-perfect throw loop against Zangief (Dash + walk 2f); allows a frame-perfect corner throw loop with Drive Rush (more lenient vs. Marisa/Blanka/E.Honda/Zangief); throw pressure is more effective when mixed with other DR buttons, or feints like DR~214P); can also Dash + 5MK for weak pressure and a link to 5LK on hit; Lynx Song can be used for mixups (LP Roll into 6LK/6MK to beat reversal buttons, OD Roll into 6HK to beat throws, empty LP Roll to bait Perfect Parry at only -4 on whiff); a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: 4LPLK 4LM
moves.notes: Side switches; no true throw oki even with Drive Rush (except frame-perfect DR~Throw vs. Zangief); in the corner, allows an auto-timed meaty DR~5MK that is +12 oH / +8 oB; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: HPHK DI
moves.notes: See Drive Impact . Airborne connect gives spinning juggle state on Punish Counter or corner Wall Splat with variable height.

moves.name: 6HPHK 6DI
moves.notes: Performed by inputting 6HPHK during blockstun; 5f extra recovery on hit; freezes the screen for 4f during startup; see Drive Reversal .

moves.name: 6HPHK 6DI
moves.notes: Performed by holding 6HPHK on wakeup; 5f extra recovery on hit; does not have any screen freeze except for a 12f freeze when interacting with the opponent's throw hitbox (this also refunds 1 Drive bar after punishing the throw); see Drive Reversal .

moves.name: MPMK DP
moves.notes: See Drive Parry . Perfect Parrying has only 1F of recovery and disables the opponent from canceling their attack. Perfect Parrying projectiles puts you into fixed 11 frames of recovery. After a Perfect Parry, all Super Gauge gain is reduced by 20% and Drive Gauge gain/damage is reduced by 50% for the entire punish combo.

moves.name: MPMK~66 DP~66
moves.notes: See Drive Rush ; 1-bar version performed out of a Parry; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation (if performed immediately after a successful Parry, only 1+8 startup); the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties; Distance: 0.548 (min/throw), 2.100 (min/block), 3.011 (max/final DR frame)

moves.name: MPMK or 66 DP or 66
moves.notes: See Drive Rush ; 3-bar version performed on hit/block from a cancelable normal; can also be performed on whiff from cancelable light normals; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation; the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties

moves.name: 236LK 236L or 5S
moves.notes: Shortest distance; whiffs on crouching opponents; Low Crush 15-34f; puts opponents into limited juggle state with follow-ups possible in the corner; 3f extra recovery on block/whiff; KD Advantage refers to grounded hits (varies against airborne opponents)

moves.name: 236MK 236M
moves.notes: Medium distance; whiffs on crouching opponents; Low Crush 19-39f; puts opponents into limited juggle state with follow-ups possible in the corner; 4f extra recovery on block/whiff; KD Advantage refers to grounded hits (varies against airborne opponents)

moves.name: 236HK 236H
moves.notes: Farthest distance; whiffs on crouching opponents; Low Crush 23-43f; puts opponents into limited juggle state with follow-ups like 623HK possible in the corner; 4f extra recovery on block/whiff; KD Advantage refers to grounded hits (varies against airborne opponents)

moves.name: 236KK 236XX or A[5S]
moves.notes: Whiffs on crouching opponents; Low Crush 13-35f; puts opponents into limited juggle state with follow-ups possible anywhere on the screen; some hits can whiff under high airborne opponents (at certain heights, allows a sideswitch juggle); 6f extra recovery on block/whiff; KD Advantage refers to grounded hits (varies against airborne opponents)

moves.name: 623LK 623L
moves.notes: Strong close-range anti air but cannot hit cross-up; can launch high airborne opponent high enough for a follow-up Scratch Wheel juggle (incurs starter scaling)

moves.name: 623MK 623M or 6S
moves.notes: Strong close/mid-range anti air but cannot hit cross-up; active frames 4-6 will only deal 1 hit for half damage, making early anti-air attempts weaker; can only incur starter scaling if trading with a grounded normal and landing a follow-up juggle

moves.name: 623HK 623H
moves.notes: Strong mid-range anti air but cannot hit cross-up; has the most range for grounded juggles and cancels; connecting with active frames 3-4 makes the first hit whiff (500 less damage), and active frames 5-6 make the first 2 hits whiff (900 less damage), making early anti-air attempts weaker

moves.name: 623KK 623XX or A[6S]
moves.notes: Elena's primary reversal; cannot hit cross-up; connecting with active frames 5-6 makes the first hit whiff (450 less damage), making early anti-air attempts weaker

moves.name: 214LK 214L
moves.notes: Lynx Whirl Cancels (on Hit/on Block/on PC): ~6LP -3/-12/+1, ~6MP -11/-20/-7, ~6HP -13/-22/-9; first 2 hits force stand (last 2 hits will whiff vs. crouch block); first 2 hits have an extended foot hurtbox that can only hit standing opponents (shorter range vs. crouching); block disadvantage refers to stand(crouch); 2nd hit is cancelable into Lynx Whirl (enhanced Roll) on hit/block (but not whiff); all follow-ups are interruptible on block (even if opponent is in Burnout); Lynx Whirl cancel allows Elena to keep up pressure, but does not naturally combo into the follow-ups; Counter-hit/Punish Counter bonus advantage carries through first 2 hits (CH combos into ~6MK, PC combos into ~6LK); empty ~6LP Roll is safe on hit and can bait Parry/DI/Reversals; last hit puts opponent into limited juggle state (only SA3 cancel will combo unless 214LK connects in a high juggle)

moves.name: 214MK 214M
moves.notes: Lynx Whirl Cancels (on Hit/on Block/on PC): ~6LP -3/-12/+1, ~6MP -11/-20/-7, ~6HP -13/-22/-9; first 2 hits force stand (last 2 hits will whiff vs. crouch block); first 2 hits have an extended foot hurtbox that can only hit standing opponents (shorter range vs. crouching); block disadvantage refers to stand(crouch); 2nd hit is cancelable into Lynx Whirl (enhanced Roll) on hit/block (but not whiff); all follow-ups are interruptible on block (even if opponent is in Burnout); Lynx Whirl cancel allows Elena to keep up pressure, but does not naturally combo into the follow-ups; Counter-hit/Punish Counter bonus advantage carries through first 2 hits (CH combos into ~6MK, PC combos into ~6LK); empty ~6LP Roll is safe on hit and can bait Parry/DI/Reversals; last hit puts opponent into limited juggle state (only SA3 cancel will combo unless 214LK connects in a high juggle)

moves.name: 214HK 214H
moves.notes: Lynx Whirl Cancels (on Hit/on Block/on PC): ~6LP -3/-12/+1, ~6MP -11/-20/-7, ~6HP -13/-22/-9; first 2 hits force stand (last 2 hits will whiff vs. crouch block); first 2 hits have an extended foot hurtbox that can only hit standing opponents (shorter range vs. crouching); block disadvantage refers to stand(crouch); 2nd hit is cancelable into Lynx Whirl (enhanced Roll) on hit/block (but not whiff); all follow-ups are interruptible on block (even if opponent is in Burnout); Lynx Whirl cancel allows Elena to keep up pressure, but does not naturally combo into the follow-ups; Counter-hit/Punish Counter bonus advantage carries through first 2 hits (CH combos into ~6MK, PC combos into ~6LK); empty ~6LP Roll is safe on hit and can bait Parry/DI/Reversals; last hit puts opponent into limited juggle state, allowing follow-ups like 236MK, DR~2MP, SA2, canceled SA3, or corner 236LK~623HK

moves.name: 214KK 214XX
moves.notes: Lynx Whirl Cancels (on Hit/on Block/on PC): ~6LP -3/-10/+1, ~6MP -11/-18/-7, ~6HP -13/-20/-9; first 2 hits force stand (last 2 hits will whiff vs. crouch block); first 2 hits have an extended foot hurtbox that can only hit standing opponents (shorter range vs. crouching); block disadvantage refers to stand(crouch); 2nd hit is cancelable into Lynx Whirl (enhanced Roll) on hit/block (but not whiff); all follow-ups are interruptible on block (except ~6MK trades with 4f normals if the opponent is in Burnout); Lynx Whirl cancel allows Elena to keep up pressure, but does not naturally combo into the follow-ups; Counter-hit/Punish Counter bonus advantage carries through first 2 hits (CH combos into ~6MK, PC combos into ~6LK); empty ~6LP Roll is safe on hit and can bait Parry/DI/Reversals; last hit puts opponent into limited juggle state, allowing follow-ups like 236MK, DR~2MP, SA2, canceled SA3, or corner 236LK~623HK

moves.name: 236LP 1S
moves.notes: Shortest total distance (1.37); 13f/0.72 distance before 6LK; 16f/0.87 distance before 6MK/6HK/6P; crouch-sized hurtbox 3-26f (but still considered standing); can execute the 6LK follow-up 3f earlier than the other follow-ups; Elena is in a Counter-hit state for the entire roll duration

moves.name: 236MP 2S
moves.notes: Medium total distance (1.72); 13f/0.66 distance before 6LK; 18f/0.98 distance before 6MK/6HK/6P; crouch-sized hurtbox 3-26f (but still considered standing); can execute the 6LK follow-up 5f earlier than the other follow-ups; Elena is in a Counter-hit state for the entire roll duration

moves.name: 236HP 3S
moves.notes: Longest total distance (2.21); 16f/1.08 distance before 6LK; 19f/1.35 distance before 6MK/6HK/6P; crouch-sized hurtbox 3-26f (but still considered standing); can execute the 6LK follow-up 3f earlier than the other follow-ups; Elena is in a Counter-hit state for the entire roll duration

moves.name: 236PP A[2S]
moves.notes: Follow-ups are enhanced like the Lynx Whirl versions after only one spin; total distance is between the MP/HP versions (2.075); 15f/1.01 distance before 6LK; 18f/1.28 distance before 6MK/6HK/6P; crouch-sized hurtbox 3-26f (but still considered standing); can execute the 6LK follow-up 3f earlier than the other follow-ups; this version is good for combos, pressuring from neutral, and punishing projectiles due to the faster startup on enhanced follow-ups; Elena is in a Counter-hit state for the entire roll duration

moves.name: 236P~6LP 2S~1S
moves.notes: Accessible from a previous Lynx Song or Spin Scythe; performs an extra spin, enhancing the follow-up specials (~6LK, ~6MK, ~6HK); can continue rolling indefinitely with repeated ~6P inputs; crouch-sized hurtbox 1-26f (but still considered standing); startup refers to minimum number of frames before each follow-up can come out (15-21f ~6LK, 18-21f ~6MK/~6HK, 20-21f ~6P); total roll distance: 1.43; Elena is in a Counter-hit state for the entire roll duration; safest version of empty Roll to cancel into (e.g. Spinning Scythe ~ empty Lynx Whirl to bait DI/Parry/reversal)

moves.name: 236P~6MP 2S~2S
moves.notes: Accessible from a previous Lynx Song or Spin Scythe; performs an extra spin, enhancing the follow-up specials (~6LK, ~6MK, ~6HK); can continue rolling indefinitely with repeated ~6P inputs; crouch-sized hurtbox 1-26f (but still considered standing); startup refers to minimum number of frames before each follow-up can come out (15-21f ~6LK, 18-21f ~6MK/~6HK, 20-21f ~6P); total roll distance: 1.94; Elena is in a Counter-hit state for the entire roll duration

moves.name: 236P~6HP 2S~3S
moves.notes: Accessible from a previous Lynx Song or Spin Scythe; performs an extra spin, enhancing the follow-up specials (~6LK, ~6MK, ~6HK); can continue rolling indefinitely with repeated ~6P inputs; crouch-sized hurtbox 1-26f (but still considered standing); startup refers to minimum number of frames before each follow-up can come out (15-21f ~6LK, 18-21f ~6MK/~6HK, 20-21f ~6P); total roll distance: 2.46; Elena is in a Counter-hit state for the entire roll duration

moves.name: 236PP~6P A[2S]~2S
moves.notes: Nearly identical to meterless versions except that the cancel window into follow-up specials is extended 3f longer; accessible from a previous OD Lynx Song; performs an extra spin, enhancing the follow-up specials (~6LK, ~6MK, ~6HK); can continue rolling indefinitely with repeated ~6P inputs; crouch-sized hurtbox 1-26f (but still considered standing); startup refers to minimum number of frames before each follow-up can come out (15-24f ~6LK, 18-24f ~6MK/~6HK, 20-24f ~6P); total roll distance: 2.59; Elena is in a Counter-hit state for the entire roll duration

moves.name: 236P~6LK 2S~6L
moves.notes: Elena immediately loses crouch-sized hurtbox and projectile invuln from Lynx Song (hard to use vs. projectiles); generally safe on block if spaced as a poke; punishable by most characters at closer ranges (notable exceptions: A.K.I. only gets 2LK, Mai gets nothing); combos when buffered from 2MP or 2MK~HK in neutral; puts the opponent into a limited juggle state (only into SA3 cancel except in high corner juggles); total minimum startup depends on which strength of Lynx Song was used (LP 13+10, MP 13+10, HP 16+10)

moves.name: 236PP~6LK or 236P~6P~6LK A[2S]~6L
moves.notes: Elena immediately loses crouch-sized hurtbox and projectile invuln from Lynx Song (hard to use vs. projectiles); strong ender from Spinning Scythe on hit (3f gap) to reset pressure (but does not frame trap on block); useful for pressure on block (can beat 4f normals with 2LP, catch back walk with 2LK~2LP, and throw except vs. midscreen back walk); 1f extra recovery on whiff; the version used from OD Lynx Song is not considered an OD move for cancel purposes (no SA2 cancel); puts the opponent into a limited juggle state; total minimum startup from OD Lynx Song is 15+10 (longer and variable when used from Lynx Whirl)

moves.name: 236P~6MK 2S~6M
moves.notes: Feet/leg hurtboxes are anti-air invuln while active on frames 8-10 (both the kicking leg and the topmost body hurtbox); can anti-air opponents jumping out of roll pressure, but cannot hit cross-up; maintains projectile invuln from Lynx Song to counter fireballs more effectively; Elena immediately loses crouch-sized hurtbox from Lynx Song; total minimum startup depends on which strength of Lynx Song was used (LP 16+8, MP 18+8, HP 19+8); puts opponent into a limited juggle state

moves.name: 236PP~6MK or 236P~6P~6MK A[2S]~6M
moves.notes: 2f extra recovery on block/whiff; 1st hit pulls opponents inward on hit/block for combo consistency; feet/leg hurtboxes are anti-air invuln while active on frames 8-10 (both the kicking leg and the topmost body hurtbox); can anti-air opponents jumping out of roll pressure, but cannot hit cross-up; maintains projectile invuln from Lynx Song/Whirl to counter fireballs more effectively; Elena immediately loses crouch-sized hurtbox from Lynx Song; can combo from Spinning Scythe ~ Lynx Whirl on Counter-hit/Punish Counter; puts opponent into a limited juggle state; total minimum startup from OD Lynx Song is 18+8 (longer and variable when used from Lynx Whirl)

moves.name: 236P~6HK 2S~6H
moves.notes: Low Crush 14-24f (final active frame is considered standing but still has a high hurtbox); projectile invuln disappears for a brief period after Lynx Song (less effective as a fireball counter); projectile invuln does not apply to the top of Elena's head; Elena immediately loses crouch-sized hurtbox from Lynx Song; safe overhead that can lead to a 5MK combo after baiting the opponent's throw tech; puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state on hit (can always pick up corner juggles, but midscreen juggles depend on height/spacing); total minimum startup depends on which strength of Lynx Song was used (LP 16+22, MP 18+22, HP 19+22)

moves.name: 236PP~6HK or 236P~6P~6HK A[2S]~6H
moves.notes: 2 hits (if 1st hit is blocked, 2nd hit is no longer an overhead); Low Crush 5-22f (can avoid moves before becoming airborne); projectile invuln disappears for a brief period after Lynx Song/Whirl (less effective as a fireball counter); projectile invuln does not apply to the top of Elena's head; Elena immediately loses crouch-sized hurtbox from Lynx Song; overhead that gives strong follow-up pressure on block, a 2LP on hit, and a medium combo after baiting the opponent's low buttons or throw tech; puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state on hit (can always pick up a juggle, but exact route depends on height and distance); total minimum startup from OD Lynx Song is 18+22 (longer and variable when used from Lynx Whirl)

moves.name: 214LP 4S
moves.notes: Forces stand; sways back slightly (can avoid attacks); sways on frames 5-14 (max distance of 0.40 on frame 5); puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state; safe option out of Drive Rush that can bait the opponent's button/throw and grants a light combo extension after a whiff punish

moves.name: 214MP -
moves.notes: Forces stand; sways back a moderate distance (can avoid attacks); sways on frames 5-18 (max distance of 0.50 on frame 9); puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state; safe option out of Drive Rush that can bait the opponent's button/throw and grants a 5MK combo extension after a whiff punish

moves.name: 214HP -
moves.notes: Forces stand; sways back significantly (can avoid attacks); sways on frames 5-23 (max distance of 0.71 on frames 14-16); puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state; safe option out of Drive Rush that can bait the opponent's button/throw and grants a 5MK combo extension after a whiff punish

moves.name: 214PP A[4S]
moves.notes: Forces stand; sways back a moderate distance (can avoid attacks); sways on frames 5-19 (max distance of 0.56 on frame 9); puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state; safe option out of Drive Rush that can bait the opponent's button/throw and grants a light combo extension after a whiff punish

moves.name: 214P~6P 4S~6X
moves.notes: Hitconfirmable follow-up from safe sway starter; puts opponents into limited juggle state (into SA3)

moves.name: 214PP~6P A[4S]~6X
moves.notes: Hitconfirmable follow-up from safe sway starter; puts opponents into limited juggle state (into SA2/SA3); sets up a safe jump vs. grounded opponents near the corner

moves.name: 236236K 236236L or 5/6HS
moves.notes: Good anti-air with air invuln that fully covers the first 2 hits; cannot be used as an invincible reversal against grounded strikes/throws/projectiles (making it much more dangerous to be in Burnout); cannot hit cross-up; puts opponents into limited juggle state (can combo a 236KK full connect after a grounded hit); extreme block disadvantage allows many characters to set activate installs without sacrificing optimal punish starters

moves.name: 236236P 236236M or 4HS
moves.notes: Excellent anti-fireball tool due to its invincibility and forward movement; slow startup makes it risky as a reversal (can be safely meatied by light normals); leaves Elena farther away than the Healing version, but with more advantage for Lynx Song or Drive Rush pressure; generally a poor anti-air but can catch some mid-range neutral jumps or divekick landing recovery; has a large combo-only hitbox that makes it more consistent in juggles; opponents can jump after the Super freeze to avoid a chip KO

moves.name: 236236P~[2] 236236M/4HS~[2]
moves.notes: Sacrifices damage and oki in exchange for healing 100 HP; the healing amount is not affected by damage scaling, making it more useful in a highly scaled combo; Elena builds 1 bar of Drive gauge when healing which also allows Drive regeneration to resume slightly earlier (also applies to Burnout gauge); excellent anti-fireball tool due to its invincibility and forward movement; slow startup makes it risky as a reversal (can be safely meatied by light normals); opponents can jump after the Super freeze to avoid a chip KO

moves.name: 214214K 214214H or 2HS
moves.notes: Cinematic time regenerates ~2.1 Drive bars for Elena; large combo-only hitbox makes it more consistent in juggles; reliable but expensive reversal when in Burnout; very consistent anti-air at mid to long range, but cannot hit cross-up and can whiff under closer jumps; opponents cannot avoid a chip KO by jumping after the Super freeze

moves.name: 214214K 214214H or 2HS
moves.notes: Available at 25% HP or below; cinematic time regenerates ~2.1 Drive bars for Elena; large combo-only hitbox makes it more consistent in juggles; reliable but expensive reversal when in Burnout; very consistent anti-air at mid to long range, but cannot hit cross-up and can whiff under closer jumps; opponents cannot avoid a chip KO by jumping after the Super freeze

moves.name: 5PPPKKK 5LMHS+DP+A
moves.notes: "It's such a lovely day. And I hope you're having a good one too!"

moves.name: 6PPPKKK 6LMHS+DP+A
moves.notes: "One, two, and spin! What do you say? How about you dance with me!"; overrides the current background music with the Reniala Remains stage theme with increased volume

moves.name: 4PPPKKK 4LMHS+DP+A
moves.notes: "And up!"; can hold forward or back to transition into a hand-walking animation on frames 181-370

moves.name: 4PPPKKK~6 4LMHS+DP+A~6
moves.notes: "Cool right? Give it a try!"; cannot change walk animation once it has begun; total animation time depends on when Forward was input during the initial Back Taunt

moves.name: 4PPPKKK~4 4LMHS+DP+A~4
moves.notes: "Hehe, over here!"; cannot change walk animation once it has begun; total animation time depends on when Back was input during the initial Back Taunt

moves.name: 2PPPKKK 2LMHS+DP+A
moves.notes: "What's up?"

Sagat.intro:
The Emperor of Muay Thai. He was once one of the highest ranking members of Shadaloo, but has since left the criminal organization. He currently lives deep in the mountains, focusing only on his training.

In a reversal of his usual style, Sagat is a projectile zoner second and a brawler first with an emphasis on scary, safe pressure moves that make him a true titan up close. With excellent offensive and defensive tools, Sagat controls the screen with his superior battle prowess while giving up nothing when up close.

What you'll likely notice first about Sagat is his enormous frame. Easily the largest character on the roster , Sagat stands tall above his foes. This frame gives Sagat excellent poking normals, such as his 5HP , 5MK , and 2MK , all of which have ludicrous reach. Once Sagat has claimed the space in front of him as his own, he can begin layering in his strong zoning game. Sagat's signature move is his infamous Tiger Shot , fast projectiles that can be fired from either chest or knee height. Each version of Tiger Shot has its own purpose; the LP version forces opponents t

moves.name: 5LP 2L/A[L]~5L
moves.notes: Chains into 5LP/2LP/2LK; great range for a chainable 5f jab (but slightly shorter than a standard shoto 5LK); DR cancel is delayed until after 2nd recovery frame; Sagat's only light normal that combos naturally into 214LK

moves.name: 5MP -
moves.notes: Core pressure tool for frame traps (5MPx2 sets up a trade combo vs. most reversal 4f normals); pushback on block is too far for a throw mixup without Drive Rush; links consistently into 2MP on counter-hit or into 5HK on Punish Counter (very strong Drive Reversal punish option); on regular hit can lead to 5MP, 5MP, 5LP combo

moves.name: 5HP 5H
moves.notes: 3f extra recovery on whiff; huge range poke with a hitconfirmable TC follow-up; the first 10 recovery frames extend a wide arm-height hurtbox making it easily whiff punished by standing normals

moves.name: 5LK 5L
moves.notes: Long range but slow startup (more comparable to a medium normal); 2f extra recovery on whiff; great whiff punish tool that combos consistently into 623HP on Punish Counter; input overlap with 6LK Low Step Kick makes it harder to walk forward and poke in neutral; DR cancel is delayed until after 3rd recovery frame

moves.name: 5MK 5M
moves.notes: Very long poke with a semi-hitconfirmable TC follow-up; more range vs. standing opponents (the tip of the hitbox whiffs on crouching opponents); the first 10 recovery frames extend a wide leg hurtbox making it more easily whiff punished by standing normals; extends a wider body hurtbox for the entire whiff recovery

moves.name: 5HK A[H]
moves.notes: Upper Body/Leg hurtbox is anti-air invincible on frames 9-15 (solid anti-air against midrange jumps); cannot hit cross-up; 1st hit forces stand on hit; 2nd hit whiffs on crouching opponents (2f worse on block); 4f extra recovery if both hits whiff; 1st hit deals extra hitstun, allowing a natural combo into 214HK; deals full damage / Drive damage / Meter gain even if only the 2nd hit connects; 1st hit puts airborne opponents into a free juggle state (limited juggle if comboed from a wallsplat or airborne crumple), then air resets on the 2nd hit; 2nd hit only has juggle potential after the 1st hit connects; the first 11 recovery frames extend a wide leg hurtbox making it more easily whiff punished by standing normals; carries counter-hit/Punish Counter advantage through both hits

moves.name: 2LP 2L
moves.notes: Chains into 5LP/2LP/2LK; excellent range for a 4f jab; high pushback makes tick throw and counter-hit pressure weaker, but also allows Sagat to space himself outside the opponent's reversal normals on block; DR cancel is delayed until after 2nd recovery frame (up to the 3rd recovery frame); topmost hurtbox on frames 1-5 is vulnerable only to aerial strikes (preventing its use as an anti-air)

moves.name: 2MP A[M]
moves.notes: Solid mid-range cancelable poke and buffer tool; 1f extra recovery on block; 3f extra recovery on whiff; significantly more range on active frames 2-3 (more effective linking from +8 or punishing -8 moves); cancelable into 2 different Target Combo follow-ups with different hitconfirm timings (requires Punish Counter or Drive Rush for 2MP~HP combo); topmost hurtbox is vulnerable only to aerial strikes on frames 1-9 (preventing its use as an anti-air), and is projectile invincible on frames 1-14 to avoid High Tiger Shot (frames 15-26 are still vulnerable)

moves.name: 2HP 2H
moves.notes: Very long range for a cancelable and hitconfirmable poke; significantly more range on active frames 3-4; topmost hurtbox is vulnerable only to aerial strikes on frames 1-14 (preventing its use as an anti-air), and is projectile invincible on frames 1-19 to avoid High Tiger Shot (frames 20-35 are still vulnerable)

moves.name: 2LK A[L]
moves.notes: Chains into 5LP/2LP/2LK; low starter that can combo into any 3-light chain from close range

moves.name: 2MK 2M
moves.notes: Amazing hitbox priority as a neutral poke; can link to 5LP at closer ranges, or into 2MP/5LK on Counter-hit; useful combo/pressure starter out of Drive Rush (but has poor link options near its max range)

moves.name: 2HK 3H
moves.notes: Has some juggle potential; great range and hitbox priority; can be punished on block by most other sweeps in the game

moves.name: j.LP j.L
moves.notes: Fast air-to-air with solid horizontal range

moves.name: j.MP j.M
moves.notes: 2 hits; puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; if 1st hit is stand blocked, the 2nd hit will not hit overhead against crouch block; lower body projectile invuln 8-22f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: j.HP j.A[H]
moves.notes: Strong downward attack angle; spike knockdown vs. airborne opponents; lower body projectile invuln 10-22f (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: j.LK j.A[L]
moves.notes: Cross-up; can be used as a fuzzy instant overhead

moves.name: j.MK j.A[M]
moves.notes: Long horizontal range (barely shorter than j.HK) with a better downward attack angle and nearly identical hitstun and blockstun; lower body projectile invuln 8-25f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: j.HK j.H
moves.notes: Longest horizontal range; puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; lower body projectile invuln 10-21f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: 6MP 6M
moves.notes: Spike knockdown vs. airborne opponents; Drive Rush gives a combo into 2MP (no real strike/throw pressure on block); meaty timing allows a follow-up link (up to +5/0 on final active frame)

moves.name: 4HP 4H
moves.notes: Tall hitbox on 2nd hit, but also extends a tall hurtbox with no anti-air invincibility (likely to lose/trade with jump-ins); cannot hit cross-up; 2nd hit whiffs on crouch blocking opponents (3f worse on block and not cancelable); cancel does not occur until the 2nd hit's active frames (still executes on hit even if the 2nd hit whiffs); puts opponents into a limited juggle state (can combo into 236MP, DR~delay 4HP > 236HK, 623MP for great midscreen damage and corner carry); free juggle state from DR~4HP, allowing a more optimal corner juggle: > 214MK, 4HP > 236HK, 623MP; launches higher on Counter-hit/Punish Counter (KD +41) or on airborne opponents (KD +40); 1st hit puts opponent into a free juggle OTG bounce state that is usually overwritten by the 2nd hit (but can still occur on trades or when hitting extended hurtboxes)

moves.name: 6LK 6L
moves.notes: Long range advancing low poke that leaves Sagat close for a strike/throw mixup on hit while remaining safe on block; 3f extra recovery on whiff; can link into light normals on Counter-hit, or into 2MP after Drive Rush or Punish Counter; knocks down airborne opponents (KD +35~38) when juggled into (but has no juggle potential on its own); the first 7 recovery frames extend a wide foot hurtbox making it more easily whiff punished by low-reaching normals

moves.name: 6HK 6H
moves.notes: Upper Body/Leg hurtbox is anti-air invincible on frames 14-19 (useful as a predictive long range anti-air); whiffs on crouching opponents; puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; Punish Counter staggers grounded opponents and puts airborne opponents into a free juggle state; 3f fewer total frames on block/parry/armor (active frames end upon contact, with variable recovery depending on which active frame connected); the first 5 recovery frames extend a wide hurtbox where the kicking leg was (too high for many attacks to easily connect as a whiff punish); extends hurtbox 1f before active that is vulnerable to projectiles; useful in Drive Rush cancel routes from 2HP/5HK/2MP~HP (but the pushback prevents Sagat's usual midscreen link of 4HP > 236MP, juggle DR~4HP)

moves.name: 5MK~HK 5M~M
moves.notes: Always a true blockstring even at max delay; somewhat hitconfirmable knockdown from a very strong midrange poke; puts opponent into a limited juggle state (can combo 623LP after DI wallsplat on hit)

moves.name: 5HP~HK 5H~H
moves.notes: Both hits are always a true blockstring; hitconfirmable knockdown from a very strong midrange poke; sets up a KD +42 safe jump when juggled into (like after a DI wallsplat on hit/block)

moves.name: 2MP~HP A[M]~H
moves.notes: Combos after Punish Counter or Drive Rush 2MP only; () refers to scaled damage after 2MP combo starter; causes limited juggle OTG bounce vs. airborne opponents

moves.name: 2MP~HK A[M]~2H
moves.notes: 3f blockstring gap between hits; () refers to scaled damage after 2MP combo starter; harder to confirm into from 2MP but combos naturally; launch only allows a canceled Super but no other follow-up juggles; easily hitconfirmed into Super even if only the 2nd hit connects as a frame trap; higher KD advantage when juggled into

moves.name: LPLK LM
moves.notes: Can use Drive Rush for a corner throw loop with 4f timing on standard characters; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: 4LPLK 4LM
moves.notes: Side switch; no true oki after throwing opponent into the corner, but can pressure with Tiger Shot, MK/HK Knee, or spaced Drive Rush normals; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: HPHK DI
moves.notes: See Drive Impact . Airborne connect gives spinning juggle state on Punish Counter or corner Wall Splat with variable height.

moves.name: 6HPHK 6DI
moves.notes: Performed by inputting 6HPHK during blockstun; 5f extra recovery on hit; freezes the screen for 4f during startup; see Drive Reversal .

moves.name: 6HPHK 6DI
moves.notes: Performed by holding 6HPHK on wakeup; 5f extra recovery on hit; does not have any screen freeze except for a 12f freeze when interacting with the opponent's throw hitbox (this also refunds 1 Drive bar after punishing the throw); see Drive Reversal .

moves.name: MPMK DP
moves.notes: See Drive Parry . Perfect Parrying has only 1F of recovery and disables the opponent from canceling their attack. Perfect Parrying projectiles puts you into fixed 11 frames of recovery. After a Perfect Parry, all Super Gauge gain is reduced by 20% and Drive Gauge gain/damage is reduced by 50% for the entire punish combo.

moves.name: MPMK~66 DP~66
moves.notes: See Drive Rush ; 1-bar version performed out of a Parry; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation (if performed immediately after a successful Parry, only 1+8 startup); the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties; Distance: 0.546 (min/throw), 1.869 (min/block), 3.156 (max/final DR frame)

moves.name: MPMK or 66 DP or 66
moves.notes: See Drive Rush ; 3-bar version performed on hit/block from a cancelable normal; can also be performed on whiff from cancelable light normals; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation; the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties

moves.name: 236LP 1S
moves.notes: Fast 1-hit projectile (speed is not variable); can hit crouching opponents unlike MP/HP High Tiger Shot; has extremely long recovery compared to most projectiles (more vulnerable to jumps, Drive Impact, projectile invuln moves, and Perfect Parry + Drive Rush); the projectile travels low to the ground, preventing many low profile attacks from avoiding it (e.g. Kimberly's slide, A.K.I.'s Sinister Slide); Sagat is in a crouching state for the entire move duration with crouch-sized hurtboxes; puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; extends a slight projectile invincible arm hurtbox on frames 16-43 and a leg hurtbox on frames 14-50; topmost hurtboxes are vulnerable only to air attacks on frames 1-50 (more vulnerable to jump-ins despite crouching) and are projectile invincible on frames 1-31 to avoid High Tiger Shot (frames 32-50 are still vulnerable)

moves.name: 236LPMP or 236LPHP A[1S]
moves.notes: Fast 2-hit OD projectile; can hit crouching opponents; can be used while a meterless Tiger Shot is still on-screen; the projectile travels low to the ground, preventing many low profile attacks from avoiding it (e.g. Kimberly's slide, A.K.I.'s Sinister Slide); Sagat is in a crouching state for the entire move duration with crouch-sized hurtboxes; puts opponents into a limited juggle state; extends a slight projectile invincible arm hurtbox on frames 16-37 and a leg hurtbox on frames 12-44; topmost hurtboxes are vulnerable only to air attacks on frames 1-44 (more vulnerable to jump-ins despite crouching) and are projectile invincible on frames 1-29 to avoid High Tiger Shot (frames 30-44 are still vulnerable); starter scaling does not apply if only the 2nd hit connects (e.g. clashing with 1-hit OD fireball or breaking Drive Impact armor)

moves.name: 236MP 2S
moves.notes: Medium speed 1-hit projectile (comparable to a shoto HP fireball, but much slower than Sagat's other projectiles); whiffs on crouching opponents unless they extend an upward hurtbox; puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state (useful juggle tool after 4HP launch); has much better recovery and frame advantage than the Low version; can be used meaty on the opponent's wakeup even if they crouch block, but the opponent can input a crouching button to avoid blocking the projectile; extends a slight projectile invincible arm hurtbox on frames 18-32 and a leg hurtbox on frames 18-42

moves.name: 236HP 3S
moves.notes: Fast 1-hit projectile; whiffs on crouching opponents unless they extend an upward hurtbox; puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; has much better recovery and frame advantage than the Low version; can be used meaty on the opponent's wakeup even if they crouch block, but the opponent can input a crouching button to avoid blocking the projectile; extends a slight projectile invincible arm hurtbox on frames 14-28 and a leg hurtbox on frames 14-42

moves.name: 236MPHP A[2S]
moves.notes: Extremely fast 3-hit OD projectile; slow startup but very powerful in fireball wars once released; can hit crouching opponents unlike the MP/HP High Tiger Shots; can be used while a meterless Tiger Shot is still on-screen; excellent frame advantage on hit or block; puts opponents into a limited juggle state; can juggle into SA1 from anywhere on the screen, and into another OD High Tiger Shot from fullscreen (or at close range vs. cornered opponents); extends a slight projectile invincible arm hurtbox on frames 25-41 and a leg hurtbox on frames 25-48; starter scaling does not apply if only the 3rd hit connects (e.g. clashing with 2-hit OD fireball or breaking Drive Impact armor)

moves.name: 623LP 623L or 6S
moves.notes: Sagat's primary anti-air with fast startup but short range; deals 300 less damage on active frames 4-10; cannot hit cross-up; puts opponent into a limited juggle state (allows SA3 cancel on active frames 1-2 only)

moves.name: 623MP 623M
moves.notes: Much more range than LP version for mid-range anti airs and more consistent cancels from light normals; much slower startup (limits usefulness in many juggles); forward movement makes Sagat more likely to whiff under an opponent's jump-in; deals 600 less damage on active frames 4-10; cannot hit cross-up; puts opponent into a limited juggle state (allows SA3 cancel on active frames 1-2 only)

moves.name: 623HP 623H
moves.notes: Extremely long range but slow startup (cannot combo naturally from light normals, but works well as a combo ender from 5LK whiff punish); deals 600 less damage on active frames 3-10; cannot hit cross-up; can be charged into a much stronger version by holding the button 24 frames; releasing the button early results in uncharged 623HP with 8f startup after release; if partially charged, the Air Invuln is 1-9f then 1-11f after the button is released, and the airborne frames are 12-57f after the button is released; puts opponent into a limited juggle state (allows SA3 cancel on active frames 1-2 only)

moves.name: 623[HP] 623[H]
moves.notes: Button must be held 24f for fully charged version; causes a wall splat on hit that leaves Sagat at a fixed distance (no follow-up combo); deals 1100 less damage on active frames 4-10 with no wallsplat animation (KD +29 on active frame 4); cannot hit cross-up; 1st hit puts opponent into a limited juggle state (allows SA3 cancel on active frames 1-3 only)

moves.name: 623PP 623XX or A[6S]
moves.notes: Sagat's main reversal; slightly slower than most OD reversals (can be safejabbed by Dee Jay 5LP but is otherwise reliable); deals less damage if it connects on later active frames (1st hit deals significant portion of overall damage); cannot hit cross-up

moves.name: 236LK 236L
moves.notes: Shortest horizontal distance; no front leg hurtbox on frames 10-12 (helps avoid low pokes); 3f extra landing recovery when absorbed by armor; much better block advantage (up to +2) when spaced at max range; active frames 2-10 whiff on crouching opponents; this means that if the Knee is spaced out so the first active frame whiffs, it always connects on the last active frame vs. crouching opponents (+2 on block, 623LP juggle on hit); puts opponent into a limited juggle state (in the corner, can juggle 623LP if the last active frame connects); blocked Knee causes a screen shake when Sagat has frame advantage; can be whiffed in some situations for a side switch vs. knocked down opponents

moves.name: 236MK 236M or 5S
moves.notes: Medium horizontal distance; no front leg hurtbox on frames 14-15 (helps avoid low pokes); 3f extra landing recovery when absorbed by armor; much better block advantage (up to +3) when spaced at max range; active frames 2-9 whiff on crouching opponents; this means that if the Knee is spaced out so the first active frame whiffs, it connects on the 2nd to last active frame vs. crouching opponents (+2 on block, 623LP juggle on hit); puts opponent into a limited juggle state (in the corner, can juggle 623LP if the last 4 active frames connect); blocked Knee causes a screen shake when Sagat has frame advantage; can be whiffed in some situations for a side switch vs. knocked down opponents; sets up midscreen safe jump in certain juggle scenarios (e.g. after juggled 2MP~HP)

moves.name: 236HK 236H
moves.notes: Furthest horizontal distance; much better block advantage when spaced at max range; 2nd hit active frames 1-9 whiff on crouching opponents; this means that if the Knee is spaced out so the first hit whiffs, it connects on the 2nd to last active frame vs. crouching opponents (+4 on block); if the 1st hit is crouch blocked, opponent cannot switch to stand block the 2nd hit; puts opponent into a limited juggle state (in the corner, can juggle 623LP if the last 6 active frames connect, or 623MP / SA2 if the final active frame connects); blocked Knee causes a screen shake when Sagat has frame advantage; Sweet Spot occurs when juggling into the 3rd or 4th active frame, dealing 1300 damage (single hit) with a higher spinning juggle launch (ensures a follow-up juggle is possible even midscreen); the 2nd hit's extended Knee hitbox is too high to connect on standing characters on active frames 2-7 (tall characters: active frames 4-6); sets up corner safe jump in certain juggle scenarios (e.g. after juggled 2MP~HP)

moves.name: 236KK 236XX or A[5S]
moves.notes: 1st hit transitions to a different follow-up on hit, resulting in higher damage and a tumbling +66 knockdown (allows a 623LP juggle in the corner); if 1st hit whiffs, the next 2 hits deal 500 damage each and give a worse knockdown (only 1 hit at farthest ranges); safe on block but usually lands inside the opponent's throw range; 2nd hit active frames 2-10 whiff on crouching opponents; this means that if the Knee is spaced out, it connects on the last active frame vs. crouching opponents (+1 on block); unlike HK Knee, the opponent can switch to stand block after the first hit connects, leaving Sagat at -2; blocked Knee causes a screen shake when Sagat has frame advantage; later hits put opponent into a limited juggle state (in the corner, can juggle 623LP)

moves.name: 214LK 214L
moves.notes: 1f extra recovery vs. armor (DI is a guaranteed punish if not canceled to SA3); the only strength of 214K that can combo naturally from 5LP (3-light confirm can reach if point blank, but results in weaker mixup from ~6LK ender); does not frame trap when canceled on block (except from Light normals with Drive Rush or Burnout); combos into 6LK/6MK follow-ups; canceling into the 6HK follow-up leaves a 2f gap on hit / 9f gap on block (loses to 4f normals even in Burnout); Counter-hit/Punish Counter puts the opponent into a limited juggle state that allows the 6HK follow-up to combo; cannot perform follow-up attacks on whiff; opponents can beat all follow-ups with invincible reversals (but standard 6f reversals will not punish 214LK); if the opponent attempts to punish 214LK, the 6LK follow-up will frame trap on block (must delay 6LK vs. Burnout)

moves.name: 214MK 214M or 4S
moves.notes: 1f extra recovery vs. armor (DI is a guaranteed punish if not canceled to SA3); combos into 6LK/6MK follow-ups; canceling into the 6HK follow-up leaves a 2f gap on hit / 9f gap on block (loses to 4f normals even in Burnout); Counter-hit/Punish Counter puts the opponent into a limited juggle state that allows the 6HK follow-up to combo; 214MK combos from canceled 2MP/2HP/5HK (these cancels also frame trap on block); cannot perform follow-up attacks on whiff; lacks natural juggle potential but can juggle after DR~4HP (free juggle state) for a powerful 1-bar corner combo (DR~4HP > 214MK, 4HP > 236HK, 623MP); opponents can beat all follow-ups with invincible reversals (but standard 6f reversals will not punish 214MK); if the opponent attempts to punish 214MK, the 6LK follow-up will frame trap on block (must delay 6LK vs. Burnout)

moves.name: 214HK 214H
moves.notes: Slow startup, only combos naturally from the first hit of 5HK (requires Drive Rush or Punish Counter to combo from 2HP, 4HP launch, or 5HK 2nd hit); 214HK cannot frame trap when canceled from a normal (except for Burnout + Drive Rush into 2MP/2HP/5HK); combos naturally into all follow-ups including 6HK; cancel into 6HK follow-up leaves a 7f gap on block (can frame trap 4f normals in Burnout); 2f extra recovery on Perfect Parry only; if the 1st hit is Perfect Parried, 2nd hit will interrupt any punish slower than 5f startup (trades with 6f attacks); cannot perform follow-up attacks if both hits whiff; carries Counter-hit/Punish Counter advantage through both hits; can juggle after DR~4HP (easier execution but less damaging than his MP Tiger Shot juggle sequence); opponents can beat all follow-ups with invincible reversals (but standard 6f reversals will not punish 214HK)

moves.name: 214KK 214XX or A[4S]
moves.notes: Similar to HK version but faster (can cancel from more starters like 2HP, 4HP launch, and 5HK 2nd hit); combos naturally into all follow-ups including 6HK; cancel into 6HK follow-up leaves a 7f gap on block (can frame trap 4f normals in Burnout); 2f extra recovery on Perfect Parry only; if the 1st hit is Perfect Parried, 2nd hit will interrupt any punish slower than 5f startup (trades with 6f attacks); cannot perform follow-up attacks if both hits whiff; carries Counter-hit/Punish Counter advantage through both hits; opponents can beat all follow-ups with invincible reversals (but standard 6f reversals will not punish 214KK)

moves.name: 214K~6LK 214X/4S~6L
moves.notes: Mixup tool that is unsafe on block; the threat of overhead makes ~6MK follow-up stronger while the threat of a frame trap makes ~6HK follow-up stronger; safe vs. Burnout but no longer frame traps (unless the 6LK input is delayed from 214LK/MK); puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state (e.g. after Counter-hit 214LK/MK); causes immediate knockdown on Counter-hit/Punish Counter; loses to reversal Drive Impact after blocked 214LK/MK (but safe after 214HK unless the 6LK input is delayed); if used from a 2-light chain, opponent is in range for Throw or 2LK~5LP chain (too far if starting with 3-light chain)

moves.name: 214KK~6LK 214XX/A[4S]~6L
moves.notes: Mixup tool that is safe on block; +1 vs. Burnout (but no longer frame traps and has no real looping pressure); the threat of overhead makes ~6MK follow-up stronger while the threat of a frame trap makes ~6HK follow-up stronger; puts opponents into limited juggle OTG bounce state on counter-hit or airborne hit (KD +47, can juggle into 623MP, SA2, SA3, 2HK, or 236LPMP which combos to SA1 in the corner); safe to reversal Drive Impact after blocked 214KK unless the 6LK input is delayed

moves.name: 214K~6MK 214X/4S~6M
moves.notes: Whiffs on crouching opponents; 2f extra recovery on whiff; puts opponent into a limited juggle state (only allows 623LP/PP juggle in the corner, or 623MP from CH/PC 214LK/MK launch); frame data vs. crouch from 214LK/214MK: -19 oH / -26 oB / KD +51 onPC launch; frame data vs. crouch from 214HK: -17 oH / -24 oB / -13 onPC (214HK keeps opponent crouching on Punish Counter); safe to reversal Drive Impact after blocked 214K; 5f blockstring gap after 214LK/MK (loses to reversal standing/crouching 4f normals); 3f blockstring gap after 214HK (frame trap vs. standing normals but still loses to reversal crouching normals); risky to attempt on block, but the threat of the overhead and frame trap from ~6LK follow-up can condition opponents to stand block or parry; opponent cannot walk back out of throw range on block

moves.name: 214KK~6MK 214XX/A[4S]~6M
moves.notes: Whiffs on crouching opponents; 2f extra recovery on whiff; puts opponent into a limited juggle state (no midscreen juggle besides SA2/SA3 cancel); in the corner, can juggle into 623MP/PP, 2HK, or SA2 from a grounded hit, in addition to 236LK, 236LPMP, SA1, or SA3 on an airborne connect (e.g. 4HP launch or DI wallsplat); frame data vs. crouch from 214KK: -17 oH / -24 oB / -13 onPC; safe to reversal Drive Impact after blocked 214KK; 3f blockstring gap after 214KK (frame trap vs. standing normals but still loses to reversal crouching normals); risky to attempt on block, but the threat of the overhead and frame trap from ~6LK follow-up can condition opponents to stand block or parry; opponent cannot walk back out of throw range on block

moves.name: 214K~6HK 214X/4S~6H
moves.notes: Connects on both standing/crouching opponents; launches opponent into a limited juggle state; only combos naturally from 214HK (requires juggle state for LK/MK versions, like a CH/PC Tiger Nexus); after blocked 214LK/MK, interruptible 9f blockstring gap (5f gap vs. Burnout, loses to 4f normals); after blocked 214HK, interruptible 7f blockstring gap (frame trap vs. Burnout); unsafe to reversal Drive Impact and susceptible to Perfect Parry on reaction (becomes DI-safe from 214HK if opponent delays it by 2f or longer); opponent is left inside throw range on block (but Sagat cannot shimmy an immediate throw tech)

moves.name: 214KK~6HK 214XX/A[4S]~6H
moves.notes: Connects on both standing/crouching opponents; launches opponent into a limited juggle state; combos naturally from 214KK; after blocked 214KK, interruptible 7f blockstring gap (frame trap vs. Burnout); unsafe to reversal Drive Impact and susceptible to Perfect Parry on reaction (becomes DI-safe from 214KK if opponent delays it by 2f or longer); opponent is left inside throw range on block (but Sagat cannot shimmy an immediate throw tech)

moves.name: 236236P 236236L or 5/6HS
moves.notes: 8-hit Super projectile; can be used while OD Tiger Shot is on-screen (but not meterless Tiger Shot); fast travel speed allows it to be used in long range juggles; projectile speed is not affected by button strength

moves.name: 214214K 214214M or 4HS
moves.notes: Goes into one of 4 follow-ups after frame 76 on hit (depending on which direction is held while clutching the opponent); Sagat's best reversal Super (but is still slow enough to be baited by an opponent's safejab setup); can be used as a projectile counter from about half screen; Sagat has travel time throughout the active frames (takes longer than SA3 to reach full range)

moves.name: 214214K~5 214214M/4HS~5
moves.notes: Highest damage variant of SA2; leaves the opponent far away with no oki; has significant corner carry (over 1/2 screen)

moves.name: 214214K~6 214214M/4HS~6
moves.notes: Launches the opponent into a limited juggle state (juggle counter is always set to 2 regardless of previous juggle state); Hard Knockdown if the opponent hits the ground instead of being juggled; useful for corner carry, building back some Super gauge, and getting a good mix of damage + oki (but usually results in less damage than Tiger Raid)

moves.name: 214214K~4 214214M/4HS~4
moves.notes: Switches sides with opponent; leaves the opponent far away with no oki

moves.name: 214214K~2 214214M/4HS~2
moves.notes: Leaves the opponent close to Sagat for stronger oki than other versions; can walk up for a strike/throw/shimmy mixup; gives enough advantage for an immediate 6MP overhead

moves.name: 236236K 236236H or 2HS
moves.notes: Cinematic time regenerates ~1.9 Drive bars for Sagat; only 2f startup when canceled from Tiger Uppercut; can be used as a projectile counter from about half screen; slow startup makes it a risky wakeup reversal option; total damage scaling from anti-air Tiger Uppercut is 20-40% depending on which strength was used (weaker strength gives higher scaling)

moves.name: 236236K 236236H or 2HS
moves.notes: Available at 25% HP or below; cinematic time regenerates ~1.9 Drive bars for Sagat; only 2f startup when canceled from Tiger Uppercut; can be used as a projectile counter from about half screen; slow startup makes it a risky wakeup reversal option; total damage scaling from anti-air Tiger Uppercut is 20-40% depending on which strength was used (weaker strength gives higher scaling)

moves.name: 5PPPKKK 5LMHS+DP+A
moves.notes: "If you desire the throne, stand tall against the emperor."

moves.name: 6PPPKKK 6LMHS+DP+A
moves.notes: "The emperor's strength is peerless. However, it would be my pleasure to test your strength!"

moves.name: 4PPPKKK 4LMHS+DP+A
moves.notes: "If you're on a path to attain strength, show me your worth!"

Alex.intro:
A young wrestler considered to be the next big thing. He debuted with his adoptive father Tom as his trainer, but was quickly made a heel due to his perceived surliness.

Debuting in Street Fighter III and returning from SFV, Alex is once again a grappler specializing in burst movement and relentless pressure . Where Manon's gameplan is about mixups, Lily’s about stock based plus frames, and Zangief's is about landing the SPD, Alex instead is a high-aggression, high mobility brawler who specializes at getting into medium-close range and forcing your opponent into constant guesses with relentless frame advantage, attacks that hold your Drive Gauge hostage, and big damage once he lands a clean hit.

Alex’s pressure on knockdown is some of the most suffocating offense to deal with in Street Fighter 6. He can approach above, behind, low, or the front, and each has a variety of options, attributes, and follow ups. Armored attacks that leave him plus, command grabs, and sneaky resets -- and that’s only scratching the surface.

moves.name: 5LP 5L
moves.notes: Chains into 5LP/2LP/2LK; Alex's only 4f attack with above average range

moves.name: 5MP 5M
moves.notes: 1f extra recovery on block; 2f extra recovery on whiff; extends a wide arm and foot hurtbox on the first 15 recovery frames; can lead to a hitconfirmable TC knockdown; great meaty tool with very low pushback (up to +7 oH / +3 oB)

moves.name: 5HP A[H]
moves.notes: Disjointed poke with great range to harass the opponent's Drive gauge; cancelable into Super for a hitconfirm or to punish Drive Impact; extends a wide arm and foot hurtbox on the first 12 recovery frames; high active frame count for meaty setups (up to +8 oH / +1 oB, but high pushback on block); can be held for a stronger, fully cancelable version (uncharged version comes out if button is held up to 15 frames); holding the button 1-7f results in 12f startup; holding the button 8-15f increases the total startup incrementally by 1f (up to a maximum startup of 20f)

moves.name: 5[HP] A[H] (Hold)
moves.notes: Button must be held 16f (early release results in uncharged version); more damage and range than uncharged version; has juggle potential unlike uncharged version (useful in some routes like juggled SA2 when not fully cornered); puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; stops forward momentum when used out of Drive Rush (good for baiting DR checks, but will usually be out of range for link follow-ups afterward); enables true blockstring into HP Flash Chop for huge Drive damage and plus frames; true blockstring when canceled into Drive Impact (can be delayed to manually create a gap); extends a front leg hurtbox on frames 8-19 of startup (more easily counterpoked by lows); extends a wide arm and foot hurtbox on the first 15 recovery frames; can be safe to Drive Impact if absorbed late; Prowler Stance cancel: +9 oH / +6 oB

moves.name: 5LK A[L]
moves.notes: Very long range for a 6-frame button (but slow for a light normal); DR cancel is delayed until after active frames

moves.name: 5MK -
moves.notes: Foot hurtbox shifts backward on frames 5-16f (more effective at counter-hitting low pokes); long range poke with good hitbox priority and no extended hurtbox before active frames; creates a useful spacing trap against Ryu/Akuma/Terry 2MK and Ed 2MP using 5LP~2LP~2LP or 2LK~5LP~2LP that grants a Punish Counter link to 5LK; extends a wide leg hurtbox on the first 11 recovery frames

moves.name: 5HK 5H
moves.notes: Disjointed poke with great range; grounded Punish Counter crumple puts opponent into a free juggle crumple state and is +23 before opponent falls to the ground (no grounded combo possible); puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state (free juggle on Punish Counter); extends a hurtbox 1f before active that is vulnerable to projectiles; can be held for a stronger, longer-range version (uncharged version comes out if button is held up to 15 frames); holding the button 1-8f results in 16f startup; holding the button 9-15f increases the total startup incrementally by 1f (up to a maximum startup of 23f)

moves.name: 5[HK] 5[H]
moves.notes: Button must be held 16f (early release results in uncharged version); more damage, range, and juggle potential than uncharged version; stops forward momentum when used out of Drive Rush (good for baiting DR checks); Punish Counter (ground/air) puts opponent into a free juggle state; puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state on normal hit; startup frames 17-24 extend a small leg hurtbox (more easily counter-poked by standing buttons); extends a wide leg hurtbox on the first 10 recovery frames; Prowler Stance cancel: KD +42 oH / +4 oB (KD advantage varies on airborne opponents)

moves.name: 2LP 5/2L~2L
moves.notes: Chains into 5LP/2LP/2LK; topmost hurtbox on frames 1-7 is vulnerable only to aerial attacks (preventing its use as an anti-air) and is projectile invincible to avoid High Tiger Shot; DR cancel is delayed until after 2nd active frame

moves.name: 2MP A[M]
moves.notes: 4f extra recovery on whiff; topmost hurtbox on frames 1-9 is vulnerable only to aerial attacks (preventing its use as an anti-air) and is projectile invincible to avoid High Tiger Shot; Special/DR/DI cancel is delayed until after active frames; relatively poor DR Cancel options (no natural combo into 2HP > 236HP, max range cannot cancel to 4MK > 2HP, and only a true blockstring into 5LP/2LP/2LK)

moves.name: 2HP 2H
moves.notes: Forces stand; head and arm hurtbox are anti-air invuln on frames 10-14; decent anti-air but weaker against close jumps; active frames 1-2 can hit grounded or airborne and are cancelable; active frames 3-6 can only hit airborne opponents and cannot cancel; cannot hit cross-up; Punish Counter puts opponents into a limited juggle state (much higher launch vs. airborne); stand-sized hurtboxes on frames 10-30 (considered crouching); very short horizontal range (usually requires Drive Rush to combo properly); useful combo tool into Prowler Stance (combos naturally into Palm Jab) or into HP Flash Chop when used out of Drive Rush; Prowler Stance cancel: +7 oH / +4 oB

moves.name: 2LK 2L
moves.notes: Chains into 5LP/2LP/2LK; TC into 2HK requires Drive Rush/Counter-hit/Punish Counter (useful 5f punish at longer ranges, especially with Modern controls)

moves.name: 2MK 2M
moves.notes: Good low starter that links into 2LP naturally, into 5MP on counter-hit, or into 2MP from Drive Rush (except from max range); solid poke range to punish back walk

moves.name: 2HK 3H
moves.notes: Long range sweep; has juggle potential; Prowler Stance cancel: KD +24 (normal hit) / HKD +39 (PC)

moves.name: j.LP j.L
moves.notes: Quick air-to-air

moves.name: j.MP j.M
moves.notes: Puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; cancelable into j.2HP from forward jump only; can situationally combo into j.MP~j.2HP (like after regular 2PP~MP, PC 2HP, or CH/PC 2PP~HP); lower body projectile invuln 7-21f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: j.HP j.A[H]
moves.notes: Best downward hitbox priority for vertical approaches; spike knockdown on airborne opponents; lower body projectile invuln 9-24f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: j.LK j.A[L]
moves.notes: Cross-up; can be used as a fuzzy instant overhead on tall characters

moves.name: j.MK j.A[M]
moves.notes: Most horizontal range of Alex's jump-ins but more difficult to time than j.HK; requires frame perfect timing to connect on a standard crouching hurtbox (4f timing vs. tall crouching opponents); lower body projectile invuln 8-25f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: j.HK j.H
moves.notes: Decent all-around jump-in for horizontal approaches; lower body projectile invuln 10-21f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: 6MP 6M
moves.notes: Good range and damage for an overhead; when used out of Drive Rush, combos into 5MP at any range

moves.name: 4MK 4M
moves.notes: Transitions into Collapsing Driver for a cinematic knockdown on backturned opponents; good punish starter into 2MP; strong pressure tool on block (frame traps into 5LP/2LP which can link to 5MP on counter-hit, and can tick throw into 63214HP at close range); DR~4MK gives even stronger pressure (frame trap into itself or 2HP, or tick throw into 63214LP even from longer ranges)

moves.name: 4MK (Backturn) 4M (Backturn)
moves.notes: Performs a cinematic knockdown on backturned opponents; can be canceled into after 236HP on hit; counts as 2 separate moves for damage scaling; can whiff after max range 236HP on crouching opponents; deals less damage than Power Drop but maintains same side and gives better HKD oki

moves.name: j.2HP j.2H
moves.notes: Forward Jump only; can be canceled into from forward j.MP; 15f extra recovery on whiff; Alex is in a crouching state during landing recovery (standing-sized hurtbox for the first 3 frames); spike knockdown vs. airborne opponents (KD +6~14 near the opponent); leg hurtbox is projectile invuln on frame 19 until landing; useful corner escape tool (recovers far away from the opponent if not anti-aired)

moves.name: 5MP~HP 5M~M
moves.notes: () refers to scaled damage starting from 5MP (full sequence on hit does the same damage as just a counter-hit on the HP itself); easily hitconfirmable but fairly low risk and DI-safe between hits; cancelable into Prowler Stance on hit only for oki; 1f blockstring gap between hits (up to 3f if delayed, can throw off Perfect Parry timing); can be useful to stay close in Burnout (no blockstring gap but becomes +1 on block with some pushback); on block, leaves Alex in throw range if done from point blank; Prowler Stance cancel: KD +24 oH

moves.name: 2LK~2HK 2L~2H
moves.notes: () refers to scaled damage from 2LK starter; does not combo naturally (requires Drive Rush / Counter-hit / Punish Counter); allows 2LK to be a useful punish option at ranges where 2LP whiffs (and especially in Modern where Alex cannot punish with 2LP); cancelable into Prowler Stance on hit only for oki; 6f blockstring gap between the hits (interruptible on block without DR~2LK or Burnout); Prowler Stance cancel: KD +17 oH

moves.name: 2PP 2MH
moves.notes: Cannot block while in stance (counter-hit state for entire duration); Alex is in a crouching state on frame 5 onward (stand-sized hurtbox until frame 8); crouch-sized hurtbox on frames 9-15; Low Profile on frame 16~ (but does not duck under standard projectiles); can transition into one of several different follow-ups on frame 18 onward (frame 17 for Stance Exit); can be canceled with any up input (2PP~8); Alex remains in stance until canceled or hit; Alex switches facing direction when opponent switches sides

moves.name: 2PP~8 2MH~8
moves.notes: Can start exiting stance 1 frame earlier than other follow-ups; fastest total stance + exit time is 42f; Low Profile and crouch state on frames 1-9 of exit animation; Alex remains in a counter-hit state for entire exit duration; holding up direction will buffer the Stance Exit at the earliest possible timing

moves.name: 2PP~6 2MH~6
moves.notes: Distance: 1.76; cancelable into Slash Elbow (6P) on frames 1-14 (if done later, Elbow is buffered at the usual follow-up timing); can perform Tactical Hop (LK) / Air Stampede (MK) on frame 18~; can perform Stance Exit on frame 28 (final recovery frame); cancelable into other Stance follow-ups on frame 21~; maintains Low Profile / crouch for entire duration and remains in Prowler Stance afterward; holding forward does not buffer the dash (must be timed using the standard input buffer window)

moves.name: 2PP~4 2MH~4
moves.notes: Distance: 1.00; cannot cancel into follow-ups during the dash animation (except Stance Exit 1f before recovery ends); maintains Low Profile / crouch for entire duration and remains in Prowler Stance afterward; holding back does not buffer the dash (must be timed using the standard input buffer window)

moves.name: 2PP~6P 2MH~6X
moves.notes: Button strength determines distance and startup (LP shortest/fastest, HP longest/slowest); exits Stance after use; high active frame count allows it to be spaced or used with meaty timing for better advantage; Counter-hit/Punish Counter puts opponent into a limited juggle state; puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; head and arm hurtbox are anti-air invuln on frames 8-15 (LP) / 11-18 (MP) / 14-21 (HP); maintains Low Profile on startup until 5f before active; maintains crouch state until the end of active frames (standing-sized hurtboxes after the Low Profile frames end); expands significantly on the 3rd active frame making it easier to space for advantage on block; causes a screen shake effect when blocked with frame advantage (3rd/4th active frames)

moves.name: 2PP~LP 2MH~L
moves.notes: Fast and long range jab that maintains the stance's Low Profile and crouching state; cancelable into other Prowler Stance moves (except Stance Exit, Forward/Back Dash, Hyper Takedown, or Slashing Elbow) and into standard specials / DI / DR; Alex remains in stance if not canceled (forced to exit after Perfect Parry); chained jabs form a true blockstring (can chain 4 jabs on hit or 3 on block); frame advantage compares the end of the jab recovery to the opponent's hitstun/blockstun but is only really relevant for tick throws with Hyper Takedown or when using Slashing Elbow afterward; can only tick throw into Hyper Takedown (Stance LP+LK) after 1 jab

moves.name: 2PP~MP 2MH~M
moves.notes: Counter-hit/Punish Counter transitions into Falling Moon for higher damage, Hard Knockdown, and improved meter properties (regardless of whether 1st or 2nd hit connects); () refers to Falling Moon damage; not airborne despite the animation; puts opponents into a limited juggle state on normal hit; maintains Low Profile on frames 1-7 and considered crouching on frames 1-13; cannot hit cross-up but will autocorrect if input while dashing under the opponent (allows for side swap juggle routes); can be canceled into from Palm Jab

moves.name: 2PP~HP 2MH~H
moves.notes: Can be held to gain damage, 2f extra blockstun, and armor properties; puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; Counter-hit (+8) / Punish Counter (+10) puts grounded opponents into a Backturned state that can link to 4MK or MP/OD Power Drop (can whiff at long range); shorter range vs. crouching opponents; great pressure tool for depleting the opponent's Drive gauge; can be canceled into from Palm Jab (up to 3 jabs vs. standing or 2 jabs vs. crouching); uncharged version comes out if button is held up to 12 frames; can be spaced out to hit on later active frames for better advantage (up to +8/+5); holding the button 1-5f results in 12f startup; holding the button 6-12f increases the total startup incrementally (up to a maximum startup of 20f); maintains Low Profile on frames 1-6 and crouch state on frames 1-14 (standing-sized hurtbox on frames 11-14)

moves.name: 2PP~[HP] 2MH~[H]
moves.notes: More damage and blockstun than uncharged version; puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; Counter-hit (+8) / Punish Counter (+10) puts grounded opponents into a Backturned state that can link to 4MK or MP/OD Power Drop (can whiff at long range); armor absorbs 2 hits as long as the button continues to be held (armor lasts until the end of active frames); shorter range vs. crouching opponents; great pressure tool for depleting the opponent's Drive gauge; can be canceled into from Palm Jab but only combos on Punish Counter; can be spaced out to hit on later active frames for better advantage (up to +8/+7); button must be held 13f (early release ends the armor and results in uncharged version); maintains Low Profile on frames 1-16 and crouch state on frames 1-23 (standing-sized hurtbox on frames 20-23)

moves.name: 2PP~LK 2MH~2L
moves.notes: Distance: 1.157; much shorter trajectory and lower height than a standard jump; can perform air normals or Flying Cross Chop on frames 22-32 (buffers from frame 8~, then buffers a grounded normal if pressed on frame 33~); immediately loses low profile state and exits stance upon activation; prejump frames 1-2 are in a crouching state followed by a standing state on frames 3-6; Lower Body Projectile Invuln on frames 6-8 (helps jump over projectiles on startup); has a smaller body hurtbox on frames 6-33; 3f landing recovery like a regular jump but cannot block when landing from an empty jump; Alex is in a Counter-hit state for entire move duration; can be canceled into from Palm Jab

moves.name: 2PP~MK 2MH~2M
