moves.notes: Can be steered left/right; cannot hit cross-up; Alex is considered grounded on the 2nd active frame (anti-air invuln specials will lose if they don't hit before this frame); Punish Counter puts opponents into a limited juggle OTG bounce state (Hard Knockdown if no move is juggled afterward); immediately loses low profile state and exits stance upon activation (remains crouching on frames 1-8 with a standing-sized hurtbox on frames 5-8); very short hitstop gives little time for opponent to make a decision on block (significantly longer hitstop on Punish Counter for easier juggle confirms); stomp is block reactable but difficult to anti-air (can hold back to cause many anti-airs to whiff at some ranges); can intentionally whiff over the opponent to bait parry (opponent can option select with 4~4MPMK to option select a parry + Drive Rush, though the timing is strict to punish Alex); can be canceled into from Palm Jab

moves.name: 2PP~HK 2MH~2H
moves.notes: Hitconfirmable (but unsafe) long range sweep; Counter-hit/Punish Counter transitions into Flying Suplex for extra damage, meter, and a Hard Knockdown (no difference between 1st or 2nd hit of the TC when this happens); puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state (allows TC follow-up to combo); Alex remains in stance after recovery except on Perfect Parry or when Flying Suplex connects; maintains Low Profile and crouch state for entire duration; 3f blockstring gap between hits (will frame trap if opponent attempts a punish too early); can be canceled into from Palm Jab (consistent combo ender at any range)

moves.name: 2PP~HK~HK 2MH~2H~2H
moves.notes: Counter-hit/Punish Counter transitions into Flying Suplex for extra damage, meter, and a Hard Knockdown (no difference between 1st or 2nd hit of the TC when this happens); Alex remains in stance after recovery except on Perfect Parry or when Flying Suplex connects; maintains Low Profile and crouch state for entire duration; 3f blockstring gap between hits (will frame trap if opponent attempts a punish too early); leaves Alex +1 after manual Stance Exit for corner oki; can whiff when the first sweep connects at max range

moves.name: 2PP~LPLK 2MH~LM
moves.notes: Acts like a normal throw with extra range (can be teched); turns into Death Valley Bomb on Punish Counter (different animation with separate KD advantage and higher damage/meter properties); leads to good oki anywhere on screen; immediately loses low profile state and exits stance upon activation but retains crouching state on frames 1-7 with standing-sized hurtboxes; cannot be canceled into from Palm Jab (only in throw range after 1 jab on hit or block); a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: 2PP~2LPLK 2MH~2LM
moves.notes: Turns into Spiral DDT on Punish Counter (different animation with separate KD advantage and higher damage/meter properties); can only hit standing opponents; regular version gets strong meterless corner oki or Drive Rush midscreen oki; Punish Counter version can walk for meterless oki anywhere on screen; immediately loses low profile state and exits stance upon activation but retains crouching state on frames 1-14 (standing-sized hurtboxes on frames 9-14); can be canceled into from Palm Jab for a more effective tick throw; strong reaction counter to projectiles when already in stance (including invincible projectile Supers)

moves.name: LPLK LM
moves.notes: No true throw loop without Drive Rush (can dash + LP Power Bomb, dash up into spaced normals, or use Drive Rush for better strike/throw oki); DR~5HK leaves Alex +7/+2 anywhere on screen and in range for a tick command grab (HP in corner, OD midscreen); midscreen, can also hold the DR~5[HK] to throw off Perfect Parry timing or punish delay tech; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: 4LPLK 4LM
moves.notes: Side switch; no real strike/throw oki in the corner but can pressure with Drive Rush normals; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: 2LPLK 2LM
moves.notes: Leaves Alex at neutral advantage after forward dash for a pseudo-throw loop; Drive Rush allows real corner throw loops but gives weak midscreen oki; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: HPHK DI
moves.notes: See Drive Impact . Airborne connect gives spinning juggle state on Punish Counter or corner Wall Splat with variable height.

moves.name: 6HPHK 6DI
moves.notes: Performed by inputting 6HPHK during blockstun; 5f extra recovery on hit; freezes the screen for 4f during startup; 4f less hitstop on block compared to most Drive Reversals (changes the punish timing); see Drive Reversal .

moves.name: 6HPHK 6DI
moves.notes: Performed by holding 6HPHK on wakeup; 5f extra recovery on hit; does not have any screen freeze except for a 12f freeze when interacting with the opponent's throw hitbox (this also refunds 1 Drive bar after punishing the throw); 4f less hitstop on block compared to most Drive Reversals (changes the punish timing); see Drive Reversal .

moves.name: MPMK DP
moves.notes: See Drive Parry . Perfect Parrying has only 1F of recovery and disables the opponent from canceling their attack. Perfect Parrying projectiles puts you into fixed 11 frames of recovery. After a Perfect Parry, all Super Gauge gain is reduced by 20% and Drive Gauge gain/damage is reduced by 50% for the entire punish combo.

moves.name: MPMK~66 DP~66
moves.notes: See Drive Rush ; 1-bar version performed out of a Parry; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation (if performed immediately after a successful Parry, only 1+8 startup); the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties; Distance: 0.393 (min/throw), 1.722 (min/block), 3.530 (max/final DR frame)

moves.name: MPMK or 66 DP or 66
moves.notes: See Drive Rush ; 3-bar version performed on hit/block from a cancelable normal; can also be performed on whiff from cancelable light normals; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation; the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties

moves.name: 236LP 236L
moves.notes: Safe on block if spaced from a light string and maintains pressure up close on hit; has both a strike hitbox and a separate 1-hit projectile clash box during the active frames; this allows Alex to hit the opponent even when clashing with higher-priority projectiles like Supers (though it doesn't dissipate any hits of the higher priority projectiles)

moves.name: 236MP 236M or 5S
moves.notes: Can transition into Prowler Stance on hit; important combo tool that is relatively safe if spaced out; extends a large vertical combo-only hitbox for juggle consistency; has both a strike hitbox as well as a separate 1-hit projectile clash box on frames 16-20 (starting 1f before active); this allows Alex to hit the opponent even when clashing with higher-priority projectiles like Supers (though it doesn't dissipate any hits of the higher priority projectiles); can get midscreen oki with Drive Rush into a delayed button or throw; Prowler Stance cancel: KD +46 oH (variable on airborne opponents)

moves.name: 236HP 236H
moves.notes: Puts opponent into Backturned state and Forces Stand on hit; slow startup but plus on block (leaves the opponent inside OD Power Bomb range for a tick throw); true blockstring from 5[HP] dealing significant Drive damage; has both a strike hitbox as well as a separate 1-hit projectile clash box on frames 25-29 (starting 1f before active); this allows Alex to hit the opponent even when clashing with higher-priority projectiles like Supers (though it doesn't dissipate any hits of the higher priority projectiles); recovery is cancelable on hit into Power Drop (63214P) or Collapsing Driver (4MK) on frame 40 (opponent must be grounded for these to connect); can omit the follow-up cancel and link normals afterward (lights on regular hit, 5MP on counter-hit, 2HP on Punish Counter)

moves.name: 236PP 236XX or A[5S]
moves.notes: 2 hits; 1st hit keeps opponent grounded (SA2 cancel allows cinematic hit); 2nd hit puts opponents into a limited juggle state (SA2 cancel causes wall splat); can transition into Prowler Stance on hit; completely safe on block due to pushback; has both a strike hitbox as well as a separate 2-hit OD projectile clash box on frames 14-19 (starting 1f before active); this allows Alex to hit the opponent even when clashing with higher-priority projectiles like Supers (though it doesn't dissipate any hits of the higher priority projectiles); leads to good midscreen oki with Drive Rush or a 6-frame safe jump with j.HK (can often outspace 5f reversals as well); Prowler Stance cancel: KD +37 oH (variable on airborne opponents)

moves.name: 623LK 623L or 6S
moves.notes: Anti-air grab (cannot hit grounded opponents); cannot hit cross-up; best overall anti-air at closer ranges due to its fast speed and upward trajectory; allows strong meterless oki in the corner or Drive Rush oki midscreen

moves.name: 623MK 623M
moves.notes: Anti-air grab (cannot hit grounded opponents); cannot hit cross-up; more horizontal range and an extended combo-only hitbox make it useful in juggles; allows strong meterless oki in the corner or Drive Rush oki midscreen

moves.name: 623HK 623H or 2S
moves.notes: Active frames 1-2 can hit grounded or airborne; active frames 3-8 can only hit airborne; Drive/Super meter gain only applies to the first hit when blocked; cannot hit cross-up; slow for anti-air purposes but the range can be used to punish landing recovery of divekicks or similar moves; useful as a combo ender even from max range light normals; allows strong meterless oki in the corner or Drive Rush oki midscreen

moves.name: 623KK 623XX or A[6S] or A[2S]
moves.notes: Active frames 1-2 can hit grounded or airborne; active frames 3-8 can only hit airborne; Super meter gain only applies to the first hit when blocked; cannot hit cross-up; Hard Knockdown allows strong meterless oki anywhere on screen; combos and anti-airs in all the same situations as HK version (and even more lenient in juggles due to the faster startup)

moves.name: 63214LP 63214L
moves.notes: Longest range / slowest startup version; useful in some oki situations (e.g. corner throw + dash) but less useful in tick throw scenarios; turns into Power Drop on backturned opponent

moves.name: 63214MP 63214M or 4S
moves.notes: Medium range / startup version; turns into Power Drop on backturned opponent; can be used in some tick throw situations especially out of Drive Rush normals

moves.name: 63214HP 63214H
moves.notes: Shortest range / fastest startup version; turns into Power Drop on backturned opponent; most useful for tick throws when the range allows it (like after 4MK on block at point blank); Alex's strongest meterless Drive Reversal punish (but can whiff when blocked at max range)

moves.name: 63214PP 63214XX or A[4S]
moves.notes: Startup of HP version with range in between LP/MP versions; most useful overall in tick throw scenarios; turns into Power Drop on backturned opponent; more consistent and slightly more damaging as a Drive Reversal punish than HP version

moves.name: 63214P Backturn 63214X or 4S Backturn
moves.notes: Switches sides with no real oki; no difference between strengths once the grab connects; the version that comes out after 236HP has more range than any standard version of Power Bomb (but can whiff at absolute max range vs. crouching opponents); () refers to Punish Counter damage, scaled damage refers to version canceled from 236HP combo starter; backturn connect can occur even without 236HP starter (e.g. after opponent jumps over Alex)

moves.name: 63214PP Backturn 63214XX or A[4S] Backturn
moves.notes: Switches sides and leads to Drive Rush oki even midscreen; cancelable into Omega Wing Buster by inputting PP (cannot hold buttons for the entire animation, input during the 2nd body slam); () refers to Punish Counter damage, scaled damage refers to version canceled from 236HP combo starter; the version that comes out after 236HP has more range than any standard version of Power Bomb (but can whiff at absolute max range vs. crouching opponents); the starter scaling affects Omega Wing Buster damage when punishing with a raw OD Power Drop, while the combo scaling affects it when canceled from HP Flash Chop; backturn connect can occur even without 236HP starter (e.g. after opponent jumps over Alex)

moves.name: 63214PP~6 Backturn 63214XX/A[4S]~6 Backturn
moves.notes: Does not switch sides; sets up a safe jump or Drive Rush oki anywhere on the screen; cannot be canceled into Omega Wing Buster; () refers to Punish Counter damage, scaled damage refers to version canceled from 236HP combo starter; maintains the same damage scaling as the preceding OD Power Drop (does not count as a separate move for scaling); backturn connect can occur even without 236HP starter (e.g. after opponent jumps over Alex)

moves.name: 236236K 236236L or 5/6HS
moves.notes: Alex's best reversal option; sends opponent far away (oki only possible near the corner); puts opponent into a limited juggle state that can lead to trade combos depending on distance and the opponent's attack hitstun (e.g. fireball trade, early anti-air timing)

moves.name: 214214P 214214M or 4HS
moves.notes: Causes a cinematic on grounded opponents and a wallsplat on airborne opponents (can juggle in the corner); wallsplat is a free juggle state if SA2 starts the combo (otherwise, maintains the existing juggle state); can choose which version to cancel into from OD Flash Chop (1st hit stays grounded, 2nd hit launches); effective fireball counter due to range and invincibility; cinematic version gives decent Drive Rush oki (but DR~Throw can only beat reversal 4f normals on wide characters like Alex, Marisa, Sagat, Blanka, E. Honda, and Zangief)

moves.name: 63214PP~PP 63214XX/A[4S]~HS
moves.notes: Can only be performed after OD Power Drop on a backturned opponent; 2800 damage refers to base damage without scaling (1680 is the most it can theoretically do at 60% scaling); fully invincible for the entire cinematic; pushes opponent a full screen away (no possible oki); PP input must be pressed rather than held for the entire throw cinematic (timing is around the 2nd body slam)

moves.name: 236236P 236236H or 2HS
moves.notes: Cinematic time regenerates ~2 Drive bars for Alex; significantly less range than Alex's other Supers; poor oki after the cinematic (e.g. spaced DR~5MP or DR~2MK); has 2 different cinematics depending on whether it KOs the opponent

moves.name: 236236P 236236H or 2HS
moves.notes: Available at 25% HP or below; cinematic time regenerates ~2.1 Drive bars for Alex; significantly less range than Alex's other Supers; better oki than standard SA3 (e.g. DR~Throw or DR~5HP into tick MP Power Bomb); has 2 different cinematics depending on whether it KOs the opponent

moves.name: 5PPPKKK 5LMHS+DP+A
moves.notes: "Mind if... I loosen up... a bit?"

moves.name: 5PPPKKK 5LMHS+DP+A
moves.notes: "... BOOM!"

moves.name: 6PPPKKK 6LMHS+DP+A
moves.notes: "You know what I'm gonna do to you once I'm warmed up? THIS!"

moves.name: 6PPPKKK 6LMHS+DP+A
moves.notes: "Bring it."

moves.name: 4PPPKKK 4LMHS+DP+A
moves.notes: "Let's do this!"

moves.name: 4PPPKKK 4LMHS+DP+A
moves.notes: "Aaalex. Aaaalex! AAAALEX!!! AAHHHH!!"

Ingrid.intro:
A pretty, mysterious young girl who claims to travel through parallel worlds. Using a sort of crest and code, she manifests powers beyond the laws of the world. Talks like someone beyond her years.

Ingrid is a tricky zoner who likes to pester opponents around the mid-range with an array of projectiles while building up Sun Crests from afar . With enough resources, Ingrid can deal absurd damage from across the screen , but has to be careful not to be too predictable against defiant opponents.

At the mid-range, Ingrid has a fundamental zoning game. Sun Shot is a projectile that pauses briefly before traveling forward that can also be held to alter its timing against parry-happy opponents. The Light and Medium versions both shoot forward with the only difference being their initial velocity and distance before pausing, while the Heavy version shoots upward at an angle before descending. Ingrid also has Light Rising Sun as a typical anti-air with an atypical quarter-circle motion. If she has the Drive Gauge, Ingrid can combine the meterless horizontal Sun Shots with an OD angled Sun Sh

moves.name: 5LP A[L]
moves.notes: Chains into 5LP/2LP/2LK; shorter range than 2LP but links naturally into 5LP or into 2MP on counter-hit; SA2 cancel: +1/-5

moves.name: 5MP A[H]
moves.notes: Strong meaty option due to high active frame count (up to +5 oH / +4 oB); true blockstring when chained into 5MP~MK even at max delay; SA2 cancel: +5/+4

moves.name: 5HP -
moves.notes: 1f extra recovery on whiff and block; long range whiff punish tool (links to 6HP at nearly any range on Punish Counter); extends a hurtbox 1f before active that is vulnerable to projectiles

moves.name: 5LK 5L
moves.notes: Longest range of Ingrid's light normals (but relatively short for a 5f light); DR cancel is delayed until after active frames; SA2 cancel: +3/-3

moves.name: 5MK 5M
moves.notes: Has forward movement on startup (allows Ingrid to maintain a consistent corner spacing when canceling into Sun Shot); highest damage and hitstun out of Ingrid's cancelable mediums; DR/PC version combos into 236HK making it a strong whiff punish tool or DR combo extension; SA2 cancel: +10/+3

moves.name: 5HK 5H
moves.notes: 2 hits; only the 2nd hit is Super cancelable; Super cancel is delayed until after active frames; puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle OTG state that can juggle into SA1/SA3 (or pick up a post-SA2 juggle if the opponent is high enough); active frames 1-3 hit upward but have poor anti-air hitbox priority; Counter-hit/Punish Counter bonus advantage applies to both hits; strong approach tool out of Drive Rush (links to mediums on hit or grants a +2 strike/throw/shimmy mixup on block); SA2 cancel: +10/+4

moves.name: 2LP 2L/A[L]~2L
moves.notes: Chains into 5LP/2LP/2LK; more range and less pushback than 5LP but worse hit advantage (cannot link on hit to 5LK or on counter-hit to 2MP); DR cancel is delayed until after active frames; topmost hurtbox on frames 1-5 is vulnerable only to aerial strikes (preventing its use as an anti-air); SA2 cancel: +1/-4

moves.name: 2MP A[M]
moves.notes: 3f extra recovery on whiff; one of Ingrid's primary buffer tools (less range than 5MK/2HP but also less likely to be whiff punished); links into 5MP on crouching opponents or into 5LK vs. standing/crouching; high active frame count (up to +9 oH / +2 oB with meaty timing); topmost hurtbox on frames 1-10 is vulnerable only to aerial strikes (preventing its use as an anti-air); SA2 cancel: +8/+1

moves.name: 2HP 2H
moves.notes: Ingrid's longest ranged fully cancelable poke with a strong disjointed hitbox; much safer on block than most similar pokes (sets up a +3 strike/throw/shimmy mixup when used out of Drive Rush on block); has an extended hurtbox on whiff until the end of recovery; SA2 cancel: +10/+8

moves.name: 2LK 2L
moves.notes: Chains into 5LP/2LP/2LK

moves.name: 2MK 2M
moves.notes: Slightly below average range for a cancelable low poke; Special/DR cancel (but not DI cancel) is delayed until after active frames; SA2 cancel: +7/+0

moves.name: 2HK 3H
moves.notes: Solid range and hitbox priority; has juggle potential without Drive Rush

moves.name: j.LP j.L
moves.notes: Fastest air-to-air; good hitbox priority

moves.name: j.MP j.M
moves.notes: Puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; lower body projectile invuln 8-23f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: j.HP j.A[H]
moves.notes: Spikes airborne opponents on counter-hit/Punish Counter; has juggle potential (causes air reset when juggled after 236HK); lower body projectile invuln 9-23f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs); hitbox extends farther beyond Ingrid's arm (visually deceptive); best downward reach of Ingrid's jump-ins for vertical approaches

moves.name: j.LK j.A[L]
moves.notes: Cross-up; good air-to-air for potential cross-ups (e.g. E. Honda Sumo Smash, M. Bison Devil Reverse)

moves.name: j.MK j.A[M]
moves.notes: Cross-up; lower body projectile invuln 8-21f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: j.HK j.H
moves.notes: Puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state (can juggle into Target Combo extension); lower body projectile invuln 12-19f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs); best horizontal range of Ingrid's jump-ins

moves.name: 6MP 6M
moves.notes: Short range for an overhead; high active frame count (up to +6 oH / 0 oB with meaty timing for a potential meterless medium link); puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle OTG state

moves.name: 6HP 6H
moves.notes: 3f extra recovery on whiff; Low Crush on frames 9-19 (not airborne); cancelable into j.214P on hit or block (cancel is delayed until after 1st recovery frame); j.214P cancel can be interrupted with 4-5f normals or air-invuln specials; KD +10 after cancel into j.214LP; can lead to huge damage with Sun Crests and j.214PP hitconfirm; high pushback keeps it safe on block in most scenarios; puts the opponent into a free juggle state on hit or maintains the existing juggle count

moves.name: 4MK 4M
moves.notes: Foot hurtbox shifts backward on frames 5-11f (more effective against low pokes); has strong hitbox priority and a hitconfirmable TC extension; 6f blockstring gap into 4MK~HP TC (up to 8f if delayed)

moves.name: 4HP 4H
moves.notes: Whiffs on crouching opponents; slow but solid anti-air with an extremely rewarding Target Combo juggle follow-up; strong hitbox but no head or upper body invincibility (likely to trade if not timed early); puts the opponent into a free juggle state on hit; cannot hit cross-up; very short horizontal range on grounded opponents; 7f blockstring gap into 4HP~HP TC (up to 11f if delayed); Ingrid shifts backward during startup unless she is fully cornered

moves.name: 5MP~MK A[H~H]
moves.notes: Important combo tool for converting from Ingrid's 6f medium; true blockstring even at max delay; 2nd hit keeps airborne opponents in a juggle state (does not increase the juggle counter); SA2 cancel: +9/+1

moves.name: 4MK~HP 4M~M
moves.notes: TC extension that makes 4MK a solid whiff punishing tool; puts opponents into a limited juggle state and does not increase the juggle counter on airborne opponents; 6f blockstring gap between hits (up to 8f if delayed)

moves.name: 4HP~HP 4H~H
moves.notes: Whiffs on crouching opponents (opponent can crouch block even after stand blocking the initial 4HP); puts opponents into a limited juggle state; reduced KD Advantage if only the 2nd hit connects on a grounded opponent; 7f blockstring gap between hits (up to 11f if delayed); SA2 cancel: KD+53/+0

moves.name: j.HK~j.HK j.H~j.H
moves.notes: Puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; cannot hit grounded opponents (too slow to connect even after max-height j.HK); 1st hit pulls opponents inward (if the 2nd hit whiffs, opponent can fly over Ingrid for a side switch)

moves.name: LPLK LM
moves.notes: No true throw loop, but can dash to become +1 for a corner pseudo-throw loop (also in range for a 2-hit light confirm); can follow with Drive Rush normals like 5HK/2HP; can set up a LP Sun Shot that allows Ingrid to dash in with frame advantage while recovering quickly enough to anti-air if the opponent jumps out of the corner; can throw opponent into falling projectiles after SA2 activation (limited juggle state and the throw itself deals full damage); a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: 4LPLK 4LM
moves.notes: Side switch; no true throw oki after corner side switch but can threaten with ranged normals, forward dash (+0), or Drive Rush normals like 5MP/5HK/2HP; can set up a LP Sun Shot that allows Ingrid to dash in with frame advantage while recovering quickly enough to anti-air if the opponent jumps out of the corner; can throw opponent into falling projectiles after SA2 activation (free juggle state with no damage scaling, since the throw itself does not deal damage in this scenario); a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: HPHK DI
moves.notes: See Drive Impact . Airborne connect gives spinning juggle state on Punish Counter or corner Wall Splat with variable height.

moves.name: 6HPHK 6DI
moves.notes: Performed by inputting 6HPHK during blockstun; 5f extra recovery on hit; freezes the screen for 4f during startup; see Drive Reversal .

moves.name: 6HPHK 6DI
moves.notes: Performed by holding 6HPHK on wakeup; 5f extra recovery on hit; does not have any screen freeze except for a 12f freeze when interacting with the opponent's throw hitbox (this also refunds 1 Drive bar after punishing the throw); see Drive Reversal .

moves.name: MPMK DP
moves.notes: See Drive Parry . Perfect Parrying has only 1F of recovery and disables the opponent from canceling their attack. Perfect Parrying projectiles puts you into fixed 11 frames of recovery. After a Perfect Parry, all Super Gauge gain is reduced by 20% and Drive Gauge gain/damage is reduced by 50% for the entire punish combo.

moves.name: MPMK~66 DP~66
moves.notes: See Drive Rush ; 1-bar version performed out of a Parry; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation (if performed immediately after a successful Parry, only 1+8 startup); the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties; Distance: 0.375 (min/throw), 1.502 (min/block), 3.083 (max/final DR frame)

moves.name: MPMK or 66 DP or 66
moves.notes: See Drive Rush ; 3-bar version performed on hit/block from a cancelable normal; can also be performed on whiff from cancelable light normals; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation; the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties

moves.name: 236LP 5S
moves.notes: 1-hit projectile; sends a slower projectile forward a short distance that pauses before continuing forward; hold button 17f for charged version (faster ending projectile speed); puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; useful approach tool that can be followed up with Drive Rush pressure from midrange; can only have 1 meterless Sun Shot on-screen at a time (but can be used in conjunction with OD Sun Shot); projectile disappears 1f after Ingrid is hit; extends a slight projectile invuln hand hitbox on frames 18-44 and a foot hurtbox on frames 18-45

moves.name: 236MP 5[S]
moves.notes: 1-hit projectile; sends a projectile forward a medium distance that pauses before continuing forward; hold button 17f for charged version (faster ending projectile speed); puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; can only have 1 meterless Sun Shot on-screen at a time (but can be used in conjunction with OD Sun Shot); projectile disappears 1f after Ingrid is hit; extends a slight projectile invuln hand hitbox on frames 18-44 and a foot hurtbox on frames 18-45

moves.name: 236HP 4S
moves.notes: 1-hit projectile; uncharged version has 2f extra whiff recovery if the projectile does not connect within the first 40 frames; sends a projectile upward that stays active for 39f, then descends for another 20f; hold button 15f for charged version that instead flies straight forward mid-air; puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; charged version is useful for baiting a whiffed parry or punishing opponents trying to jump out of Ingrid's projectile zoning; uncharged version can be used to safely stock a Sun Crest at mid range if the opponent doesn't jump over it; can only have 1 meterless Sun Shot on-screen at a time (but can be used in conjunction with OD Sun Shot); projectile disappears 1f after Ingrid is hit; extends a slight projectile invuln hand hitbox on frames 16-45 and a foot hurtbox on frames 16-44

moves.name: 236LPMP or 236LPHP A[5S] or A[5[S]]
moves.notes: 2-hit OD projectile; LP+MP gives the shorter/slower 236LP version (most useful for approaching from midrange); LP+HP gives the farther/faster 236MP version (more useful as a traditional zoning projectile); hold button 17f for charged version (faster ending projectile speed); 2nd hit puts opponents into a limited juggle state; can only have 1 OD Sun Shot on-screen at a time (but can be used in conjunction with another meterless Sun Shot); projectile disappears 1f after Ingrid is hit; extends a slight projectile invuln hand hitbox on frames 18-44 and a foot hurtbox on frames 18-45; SA2 cancel: KD+61/+10

moves.name: 236MPHP A[4S]
moves.notes: 2-hit OD projectile; uncharged version has 2f extra whiff recovery if the projectile does not connect within the first 35 frames; sends a projectile upward that stays active for 39f, then descends for another 20f; hold button 15f for charged version that instead flies straight forward mid-air; 2nd hit puts opponents into a limited juggle state; charged version is useful for baiting a whiffed parry or punishing opponents trying to jump out of Ingrid's projectile zoning; uncharged version can be used to safely stock a Sun Crest at mid range if the opponent doesn't jump over it; can only have 1 OD Sun Shot on-screen at a time (but can be used in conjunction with another meterless Sun Shot); projectile disappears 1f after Ingrid is hit; extends a slight projectile invuln hand hitbox on frames 16-45 and a foot hurtbox on frames 16-44; SA2 cancel: KD+61/+10

moves.name: 214LP (HOLD OK) 214L or 1S
moves.notes: Builds Sun Crests up to a maximum of 4 stocks; can hold the button to extend the move and build stocks slightly more quickly (ends automatically upon reaching 4 stocks); Lv.1 (unheld version): 48F total, stock is built on frame 47 (or frame 42 when continuing to Lv.2 Hold); Lv.2 Hold: 94F total, button must be held 23F, 2nd stock is built on frame 93 (or frame 88 when continuing to Lv.3 Hold); Lv.3 Hold: 140F total, button must be held 85F, 3rd stock is built on frame 139 (or frame 134 when continuing to Lv.4 Hold); Lv.4 Hold: 186F total, button must be held 131F, 4th stock is built on frame 182; if activated with 4 Sun Crests, Ingrid instead builds 3000 Drive gauge every 46 frames (frame data is identical to the regular version but the button can be held indefinitely); Ingrid is in a counter-hit state for the entire duration; hurtbox expands upward on frames 10-44 (Lv.1) / 10-84 (Lv.2) / 10-130 (Lv.3) / 10-184 (Lv.4)

moves.name: 214MP 214M or 2S
moves.notes: 1-hit projectile hitbox; this version also comes out when input with HP button if Ingrid has 0 Sun Crests; puts the opponent into a limited juggle state (corner follow-ups possible on a high connect like 4HP~HP > 214MP); extends a foot hurtbox and a projectile invincible arm hurtbox on frames 22-41

moves.name: 214HP (1 Stock) 214H or 3S
moves.notes: 2-hit projectile hitbox; consumes 1 Sun Crest for more hits, extra damage, and longer range compared to the 0-stock MP/HP version; stock is consumed on frame 2; identical to the 0-stock OD version except for projectile priority and Super cancelability; puts the opponent into a limited juggle state (can follow up in the corner or with a midscreen DR~6HP); extends a foot hurtbox and a projectile invincible arm hurtbox on frames 19-38

moves.name: 214HP (2 Stock) 214H or 3S
moves.notes: 3-hit projectile hitbox; consumes 2 Sun Crests for more hits, extra damage, and longer range compared to the 1-stock HP version; stocks are consumed on frame 2 and the first active frame (only 1 stock is consumed if interrupted on startup); identical to the 1-stock OD version except for projectile priority and Super cancelability; puts the opponent into a limited juggle state (can follow up anywhere with 6KKK or in the corner with 236HP > 236HP for a safe jump); extends a foot hurtbox and a projectile invincible arm hurtbox on frames 19-38

moves.name: 214PP 214XX or A[2S]
moves.notes: 2-hit OD projectile hitbox; identical to the 1-stock HP version except for projectile priority and SA2 cancelability; puts the opponent into a limited juggle state (can follow up in the corner or with a midscreen DR~6HP); extends a foot hurtbox and a projectile invincible arm hurtbox on frames 19-38; SA2 cancel: KD+75/+11

moves.name: 214PP (1 Stock) 214XX or A[2S]
moves.notes: 3-hit OD projectile hitbox; identical to the 2-stock HP version except for projectile priority and SA2 cancelability; has more hits, extra damage, and longer range compared to 0-stock OD version; stock is consumed on frame 2; puts the opponent into a limited juggle state (can follow up anywhere with 6KKK or in the corner with 236HP > 236HP for a safe jump); extends a foot hurtbox and a projectile invincible arm hurtbox on frames 19-38; SA2 cancel: KD+83/+12

moves.name: 214PP (2 Stock) 214XX or A[2S]
moves.notes: 4-hit OD projectile hitbox; has properties greater than the 2-stock HP version or 1-stock OD version for 2 Sun Crests; stocks are consumed on frame 2 and the first active frame (only 1 stock is consumed if interrupted on startup); launches the opponent high into a free juggle state (can follow up with moves like 2KKK, Dash + 236HK, or Walk/Dash + j.HK~j.HK); opponent flies backward ~50% faster on airborne hits (prevents some juggle follow-ups like midscreen 2KKK); extends a foot hurtbox and a projectile invincible arm hurtbox on frames 19-38; SA2 cancel: KD+94/+16

moves.name: j.214LP j.214L or j.4S
moves.notes: Can be used during Forward/Neutral jump only on frames 17-33; builds 1 Sun Crest on frame 47 (1f before end of recovery); the animation lasts 48f regardless of when it was input during the jump (more total recovery if input late in the jump arc); landing recovery ranges from 8-30f depending on activation time; Ingrid is in a counter-hit state for the entire duration and a Forced Knockdown state during all airborne frames; if performed with 4 Sun Crests, Ingrid builds 3000 Drive gauge instead; can be canceled into from 6HP (on hit becomes KD +10, on block becomes -32 and shifts backward); extends a large full-body hurtbox for the entire move duration; can be used after midscreen 236HK (earliest timing) to gain a stock while maintaining KD +5 oki after a forward dash

moves.name: j.214MP j.214M or j.5S
moves.notes: 1-hit projectile hitbox; can be used during Forward/Neutral jump only on frames 13-37; Ingrid will land before the projectile comes out if activated on jump frame 30-37; this version also comes out when input with HP button if Ingrid has 0 Sun Crests; can be canceled into from 6HP (on hit becomes KD +36, on block becomes -11 vs. standing, -10 vs. crouching); puts opponents into a limited juggle state (corner follow-ups possible if input low to the ground); 2f extra landing recovery when performed from a neutral jump; Ingrid is in a crouching state on the final landing recovery frame; extends a large full-body hurtbox until Ingrid lands (lower body hurtbox is projectile invincible); can be used after corner 236HK launch (earliest timing), allowing Ingrid to land and build another Sun Crest without losing corner oki; hitbox is considered both a projectile and an airborne attack (loses to both types of invuln)

moves.name: j.214HP (1 Stock) j.214H or j.6S
moves.notes: 2-hit projectile hitbox; can be used during Forward/Neutral jump only on frames 13-37; Ingrid will land before the projectile comes out if activated on jump frame 30-37; consumes 1 Sun Crest for more hits, extra damage, and longer range compared to 0-stock MP/HP version; stock is consumed on frame 2; can be canceled into from 6HP (on hit becomes KD +40, on block becomes -10 vs. standing, -9 vs. crouching); puts opponents into a limited juggle state (corner follow-ups possible if input low to the ground); 2f extra landing recovery when performed from a neutral jump; Ingrid is in a crouching state on the final landing recovery frame; extends a large full-body hurtbox until Ingrid lands (lower body hurtbox is projectile invincible); hitbox is considered both a projectile and an airborne attack (loses to both types of invuln)

moves.name: j.214HP (2 Stock) j.214H or j.6S
moves.notes: 3-hit projectile hitbox; can be used during Forward/Neutral jump only on frames 13-37; Ingrid will land before the projectile comes out if activated on jump frame 30-37; consumes 2 Sun Crests for more hits, extra damage, and longer range compared to 1-stock HP version; stocks are consumed on frame 2 and the first active frame (only 1 stock is consumed if interrupted on startup or if Ingrid lands before active); can be canceled into from 6HP (on hit becomes KD +55, on block becomes -6 vs. standing, -5 vs. crouching); launches opponents upward into a limited juggle state; 3f extra landing recovery when performed from a neutral jump; Ingrid is in a crouching state on the final landing recovery frame; extends a large full-body hurtbox until Ingrid lands (lower body hurtbox is projectile invincible); hitbox is considered both a projectile and an airborne attack (loses to both types of invuln)

moves.name: j.214PP j.214XX or j.A[S]
moves.notes: 2-hit OD projectile hitbox; can be used during Forward/Neutral jump only on frames 13-37; Ingrid will land before the projectile comes out if activated on jump frame 30-37; has the properties of the 1-stock HP version without spending any Sun Crests; can be canceled into from 6HP (on hit becomes KD +40, on block becomes -10 vs. standing, -9 vs. crouching); puts opponents into a limited juggle state (corner follow-ups possible if input low to the ground); 2f extra landing recovery when performed from a neutral jump; Ingrid is in a crouching state on the final landing recovery frame; extends a large full-body hurtbox until Ingrid lands (lower body hurtbox is projectile invincible); hitbox is considered both a projectile and an airborne attack (loses to both types of invuln)

moves.name: j.214PP (1 Stock) j.214XX or j.A[S]
moves.notes: 3-hit OD projectile hitbox; can be used during Forward/Neutral jump only on frames 13-37; Ingrid will land before the projectile comes out if activated on jump frame 30-37; has the properties of the 2-stock HP version but only costs 1 Sun Crest; stock is consumed on frame 2; can be canceled into from 6HP (on hit becomes KD +55, on block becomes -6 vs. standing, -5 vs. crouching); launches opponents upward into a limited juggle state; 3f extra landing recovery when performed from a neutral jump; Ingrid is in a crouching state on the final landing recovery frame; extends a large full-body hurtbox until Ingrid lands (lower body hurtbox is projectile invincible); hitbox is considered both a projectile and an airborne attack (loses to both types of invuln)

moves.name: j.214PP (2 Stock) j.214XX or j.A[S]
moves.notes: 4-hit OD projectile hitbox; can be used during Forward/Neutral jump only on frames 13-37; Ingrid will land before the projectile comes out if activated on jump frame 30-37; has properties greater than the 2-stock HP version or 1-stock OD version for 2 Sun Crests; stocks are consumed on frame 2 and the first active frame (only 1 stock is consumed if interrupted on startup or if Ingrid lands before active); can be canceled into from 6HP (on hit becomes KD +66, on block becomes +1 vs. standing, +2 vs. crouching); puts opponents into a free juggle OTG bounce state; if the opponent Perfect Parries and Ingrid lands before all 4 hits connect, all remaining hits will fail to come out resulting in worse frame advantage; Ingrid is in a crouching state on the final landing recovery frame; extends a large full-body hurtbox until Ingrid lands (lower body hurtbox is projectile invincible); hitbox is considered both a projectile and an airborne attack (loses to both types of invuln)

moves.name: 236LK 236L or 6S
moves.notes: Strong anti-air but cannot hit cross-up; deals 200 less damage and has reduced advantage (KD +32~38) on active frames 4-10

moves.name: 236MK 236M
moves.notes: 2 hits; Low Crush 12-20f (not airborne during these frames); combos from light normals

moves.name: 236HK 236H
moves.notes: 4 hits (only 3 hits on block/whiff); Low Crush 25-35f (not airborne during these frames); on hit, Ingrid recovers mid-air on frame 77 with the opponent in a limited juggle state (can follow up with j.MP knockdown / j.HP reset / j.214P)

moves.name: 236KK 236XX or A[6S]
moves.notes: 4 hits (only 3 hits on block/whiff); Low Crush 14-26f (not airborne); safe buffer option that becomes +1 vs. Burnout; forces stand on the first 3 hits; carries over Counter-Hit / Punish Counter bonus frame advantage through the first 3 hits (affects SA2 cancel advantage); SA2 cancel: +15/+5

moves.name: 22K 22X
moves.notes: Counter that can absorb strikes (resulting in a counter-attack) or dissipate 1-hit non-Super projectiles; counter-attack is a strike knockdown that can be blocked if triggered by a low-recovery attack; counter-attack has 12f startup / 3f active / 21f recovery / 45f total animation / 1-14 fully invuln / Armor Break / no collision box 1-14f (some moves can pass through before counter-attack connects); absorbing a projectile results in 28f total recovery (often punishable if done from longer ranges); can be used to counter most strike-based Supers (useful option out of Drive Rush cancel on reaction to opponent's Super freeze); Ingrid is in a counter-hit state on frames 1-5 and a Punish Counter state for the rest of the move's duration; extends a vulnerable arm hurtbox on frames 21-36 if the counter whiffs

moves.name: 22KK 22XX
moves.notes: Counter that can absorb strikes/throws (resulting in a counter-attack) or dissipate non-Super projectiles even with multiple hits; counter-attack is a strike knockdown that can be blocked if triggered by a safe jump (3f leniency on safe jump timing); counter-attack has 6f startup / 6f active / 21f recovery / 40f total animation / 1-11 fully invuln / Armor Break / no collision box 1-11f (some moves can pass through before counter-attack connects); after absorbing a projectile hit, Ingrid incurs up to 9f fully invincible recovery per hit (refreshing for each new hit absorbed) followed by 15f vulnerable recovery; can be used to counter most Supers (useful option out of Drive Rush cancel on reaction to opponent's Super freeze); extends a vulnerable arm hurtbox on frames 21-36 if the counter whiffs

moves.name: 6KKK 6LMH
moves.notes: Teleports forward to the opponent's location and performs a kick that is safe on block; puts opponents into a limited juggle state (follow-ups possible on a corner airborne connect); can whiff in juggle routes where the opponent is flying backward too quickly; vulnerable for 8f after reappearing (can be countered on reaction)

moves.name: 2KKK 2LMH
moves.notes: Teleports above the opponent and comes down with an overhead strike that is plus on block; puts grounded opponents into a limited juggle state (follow-ups possible in the corner); puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle OTG bounce state (follow-ups possible anywhere on screen); can whiff over opponents that are walking forward; vulnerable for 15f after reappearing (can be countered on reaction)

moves.name: 4KKK 4LMH
moves.notes: Teleports away from the opponent; Ingrid is in a counter-hit state on frames 1-12 (before disappearing); after reappearing, Ingrid incurs 22 vulnerable recovery frames with an extended forward hurtbox (Punish Counter state); can use the teleport animation to bait an anti-air reaction to the Forward/Air versions of Vanishing Sun; Distance: 1.74

moves.name: 236236K 236236L or 5/6HS
moves.notes: Can hold the button to spend up to 2 Sun Crests (+400 damage per crest but reduced oki); sends opponent ~1/2 screen away on hit; Ingrid's primary reversal while in Burnout (but slow startup makes it susceptible to safejab pressure); hitbox has a dead zone that can cause it to whiff through high airborne opponents; solid anti-air but cannot hit cross-up; 1st hit deals 400 damage and puts the opponent into a limited juggle state if it trades with a projectile (high float for easy hitconfirm)

moves.name: 236236{K} 236236{L} or 5/6{HS}
moves.notes: Hold the button for 30 frames to spend 1 Sun Crest for 400 extra damage and a farther knockdown; sends opponent ~2/3 screen away on hit; hitbox has a dead zone that can cause it to whiff through high airborne opponents; solid anti-air but cannot hit cross-up; 1st hit deals 400 damage and puts the opponent into a limited juggle state if it trades with a projectile (high float for easy hitconfirm)

moves.name: 236236[K] 236236[L] or 5/6[HS]
moves.notes: Hold the button for 60 frames to spend 2 Sun Crests for 800 extra damage and a farther knockdown; sends opponent a full screen away on hit; hitbox has a dead zone that can cause it to whiff through high airborne opponents; solid anti-air but cannot hit cross-up; 1st hit deals 400 damage and puts the opponent into a limited juggle state if it trades with a projectile (high float for easy hitconfirm)

moves.name: 214214P 214214M or 4HS
moves.notes: Fires beacon into the air that spawns 3 downward-hitting Super-priority projectiles (these projectiles disappear if Ingrid is hit); button strength determines beacon position (Modern Controls: hold back/neutral/forward to control position); LP version appears in front of the opponent, MP version appears above the opponent, HP version appears behind the opponent (except at fullscreen distance); can hold the button to spend up to 2 Sun Crests for additional projectiles; projectile startup varies based on strength: LP 103f / MP 68f / HP 98f; gap between blocked projectiles is 8f / 7f (varies when switching between stand/crouch block, but always large enough to throw between projectiles); grounded opponents are put into a free juggle state by the 3rd projectile (1st/2nd keep the opponent grounded); airborne opponents are put into a free juggle state or maintain the existing juggle count; Ingrid cannot gain additional Super gauge while the projectiles are active or until the current combo ends; after SA2 activation, can combo after a Forward Throw (limited juggle) or Back Throw (free juggle)

moves.name: 214214{P} 214214{M} or 4{HS}
moves.notes: Button must be held 26f during Super freeze; fires beacon into the air that spawns 4 sets of downward-hitting Super-priority projectiles (these projectiles disappear if Ingrid is hit); button strength determines beacon position (Modern Controls: hold back/neutral/forward to control position); LP version appears in front of the opponent, MP version appears above the opponent, HP version appears behind the opponent (except at fullscreen distance); consumes 1 Sun Crest in exchange for the additional projectiles; projectile startup varies based on strength: LP 103f / MP 68f / HP 98f; gap between blocked projectiles is 8f / 7f / 10f (varies when switching between stand/crouch block, but always large enough to throw between projectiles); grounded opponents are put into a free juggle state by the 3rd projectile (1st/2nd/4th keep the opponent grounded); airborne opponents are put into a free juggle state or maintain the existing juggle count; Ingrid cannot gain additional Super gauge while the projectiles are active or until the current combo ends; after SA2 activation, can combo after a Forward Throw (limited juggle) or Back Throw (free juggle)

moves.name: 214214[P] 214214[M] or 4[HS]
moves.notes: Button must be held 71f during Super freeze; fires beacon into the air that spawns 5 sets of downward-hitting Super-priority projectiles (these projectiles disappear if Ingrid is hit); button strength determines beacon position (Modern Controls: hold back/neutral/forward to control position); LP version appears in front of the opponent, MP version appears above the opponent, HP version appears behind the opponent (except at fullscreen distance); consumes 2 Sun Crests in exchange for the additional projectiles; projectile startup varies based on strength: LP 103f / MP 68f / HP 98f; gap between blocked projectiles is 8f / 7f / 10f / 7f (varies when switching between stand/crouch block, but always large enough to throw between projectiles); grounded opponents are put into a free juggle state by the 3rd projectile (1st/2nd/4th keep the opponent grounded); airborne opponents are put into a free juggle state or maintain the existing juggle count; 5th hit puts opponent into an OTG bounce state; Ingrid cannot gain additional Super gauge while the projectiles are active or until the current combo ends; after SA2 activation, can combo after a Forward Throw (limited juggle) or Back Throw (free juggle)

moves.name: 236236P 236236H or 2HS
moves.notes: Projectile hitbox that targets the opponent's position 8f before it becomes active (can continue moving slightly upward after this point); the opponent can avoid the projectile by moving quickly (like a fast Drive Rush or jumping after the Super freeze); cinematic time regenerates ~2.1 Drive bars for Ingrid; very slow startup makes it a poor reversal

moves.name: 236236P 236236H or 2HS
moves.notes: Projectile hitbox that targets the opponent's position 8f before it becomes active (can continue moving slightly upward after this point); the opponent can avoid the projectile by moving quickly (like a fast Drive Rush or jumping after the Super freeze); available at 25% HP or below; cinematic time regenerates ~2.3 Drive bars for Ingrid; very slow startup makes it a poor reversal

moves.name: 5PPPKKK 5LMHS+DP+A
moves.notes: "Ahhh, time for a break I guess. Hmm? You too little one? Oh, you're such a little nice Monoid. Yes you are, yes you are, yes you are! See ya later!"

moves.name: 6PPPKKK 6LMHS+DP+A
moves.notes: "My power howls! Face me! Just kidding."; if opponent stands directly in front of Ingrid, she performs an attack that deals 0 damage but grants full Super gauge to the opponent on hit/block/parry; references M. Bison's back taunt

moves.name: 4PPPKKK 4LMHS+DP+A
moves.notes: "Oop, I forgot I have an urgent matter. You, babysit this one for a while."; summons a controllable Monoid that cannot block and has access to 6 attacks; LP or LK is a divekick-like move that hits low, MP or MK is an overhead, HP or HK is a high strike, HP+HK performs a beam attack, any aerial button in the air performs an aerial strike, and 214236+HP or HK performs a 3-bar Super; the Monoid is fully controllable mid-air; Ingrid comes back if the Monoid stands still or after hitting with Super; when Ingrid returns and high fives the Monoid, input LP~LP~4~LK~HK (Modern: L~L~4~M~H) to absorb the Monoid and transform into a more powerful version ("Dark Ingrid"); this transformation also fully heals Ingrid, fills her Super gauge, and grants 4 Sun Crests; Dark Ingrid gains access to 2 new Hidden Art special moves (22PPP and 214214K) and a new SA2 (360+KK)

moves.name: 2PPPKKK 2LMHS+DP+A
moves.notes: "You're done!"

moves.name: 22PPP 214214H
moves.notes: Dark Ingrid only; tall 16-hit beam projectile that reaches fullscreen; expands forward during the first 4 active frames before reaching full range on the 5th active frame; most/all hits will connect even if opponent falls into the late active frames; chip damage deals 50% of its base damage rather than the usual 25%

moves.name: 214214K 214214L
moves.notes: Dark Ingrid only; immediately puts the opponent into Burnout on hit; cannot be canceled into from normals; hits twice on hit or once on block

moves.name: 360+KK 360+XX
moves.notes: Dark Ingrid only; command grab Super; opponent cannot jump after the freeze; can be comboed into on grounded opponents; cinematic time regenerates ~1.6 Drive bars for Ingrid

moves.name: LP or LK L
moves.notes: Requires summoning the Monoid with Ingrid's Back Taunt; 3 hits (all hit low despite the divekick-like animation); can hold forward to steer and increase the attack's range; Modern Controls: L

moves.name: MP or MK M
moves.notes: Requires summoning the Monoid with Ingrid's Back Taunt; can hold forward to steer and increase the attack's range; knocks down on grounded opponents and resets airborne opponents; Modern Controls: M

moves.name: HP or HK H
moves.notes: Requires summoning the Monoid with Ingrid's Back Taunt; can hold forward to steer and increase the attack's range; knocks down on grounded opponents and resets airborne opponents; Modern Controls: H

moves.name: HP+HK S
moves.notes: Requires summoning the Monoid with Ingrid's Back Taunt; cannot steer the attack forward like the other Monoid attacks; knocks down on both grounded and airborne opponents; input has no kara-cancel leniency (must hit HP+HK on the exact same frame); Modern Controls: Sp

moves.name: j.X j.X
moves.notes: Requires summoning the Monoid with Ingrid's Back Taunt; can hold forward to steer and increase the attack's range; knocks down on grounded opponents and resets airborne opponents; gains a second hitbox on active frames 3-6 that can hit cross-up; Modern Controls: j.X

moves.name: 214236HP/HK 214236H
moves.notes: Slow 3-bar Super with low damage relative to its meter cost; unsafe on hit or block; on hit, Ingrid returns and high-fives the Monoid (can transform into Dark Ingrid using the LP~LP~4~LK~HK input before the high five, becoming much more unsafe on hit); Modern Controls: 214236H

Yasmine.intro:
A high-schooler who became a fighter to find her lost brother. She is a shy and gentle soul, but beams with confidence in fights, where she uses her Lolo's moves.

As the first Filipino Street Fighter, Yasmine zips onto the scene with blindingly high speed and relentless close quarters mixups. Boasting a lightning fast drive rush, good walk speed, a plethora of forward advancing normals and body projectile specials, a boomerang projectile that creates setups, and a wide variety of way to generate safe combo enders, Yasmine is a dizzyingly aggressive close quarters fighter.

[st HP, cr LK, safe on block body projectile, etc]

And mixups you will have to enact, because her damage is some of the worst in the game. Many of Yasmine's normals and target combos have scaling, and her bread-and-butter routing go into specials that add even more. Her Demon Raid leap and boomerang are useful tools, but in addition to being slow and vulnerable (especially compared to the wide cast of shotos) they aggressively scale when starting combos too. She suffers from weak medium ranges and awkward convers

moves.name: 5LP 2L/A[L]~5L
moves.notes: Chains into 5LP/2LP/2LK (delay required for consecutive 5LPs) or the 5LP~LP TC if chained quickly; 1f extra recovery on whiff; significantly less pushback on hit/block compared to 2LP for tick throw or DR pressure; SA2 cancel: +3/-2

moves.name: 5MP 5M
moves.notes: 2 hits; hitconfirmable pressure starter into a Target Combo extension; counter-hit/Punish Counter bonus advantage carries through both hits; 1st hit pulls opponent inward on hit/block; 2nd hit has less range but extends a wider combo-only hitbox for consistency; 2nd hit is Drive Impact punishable if the 1st hit is Perfect Parried; stops DR momentum almost immediately (weak as a DR approach tool at midrange)

moves.name: 5HP A[H]
moves.notes: 3 hits (only the 2nd hit is cancelable); core poke and combo tool with good range for whiff punishing; counter-hit/Punish Counter bonus advantage carries through all hits; very high juggle potential; can be hitconfirmed, but late cancels have reduced advantage (DRC Adv. as low as +6 oH / -2 oB, and cancels into 214MP/PP and 236MP/HP can drop); high pushback prevents most counter-hit conversions but can usually link into mediums after Drive Rush or Punish Counter; punishable by Drive Impact if either of the first 2 hits are Perfect Parried; SA2 cancel: +12/+4

moves.name: 5LK 5L
moves.notes: Great range for a 5f light normal; does not link naturally from most combo starters but useful as a neutral buffer and punish starter; can combo into 236MP on Punish Counter (important for whiff punishes since other cancels drop or are too slow); DR cancel is delayed until after active frames; SA2 cancel: +5/-1

moves.name: 5MK -
moves.notes: Solid poke with good hitbox priority; foot hurtbox shifts backward on frames 4-12f (more effective at counter-hitting low pokes); moves Yasmine forward and maintains a somewhat consistent spacing on block (but can be punished at close range)

moves.name: 5HK 5H
moves.notes: 12-16f Low Crush (not airborne); Punish Counter puts opponent into a limited juggle state (can follow with 214PP or DR~2HP anywhere or 214MP/236PP at closer ranges); great poke that can be spaced safely and is very rewarding when countering low pokes in neutral; extends a hurtbox 1f before active that is vulnerable to projectiles

moves.name: 2LP 2L
moves.notes: Chains into 5LP/2LP/2LK; Yasmine's only 4f option with fairly short range; up to +6 oH / +1 oB with meaty timing (allows stronger links or block pressure); topmost hurtbox on frames 1-6 is vulnerable only to aerial strikes (preventing its use as an anti-air); SA2 cancel: +4/-1

moves.name: 2MP A[M]
moves.notes: 2f less recovery on block compared to on hit; 2f extra recovery on whiff; great neutral buffer with good range for a 6f medium but slightly more whiff punishable than most similar normals; great pressure tool when used as a meaty or with bonus advantage from Drive Rush or Burnout; Yasmine's only medium button that combos naturally into 236HP and 214MP; topmost hurtbox on frames 1-8 is vulnerable only to aerial strikes (preventing its use as an anti-air); SA2 cancel: +12/+6

moves.name: 2HP 2H
moves.notes: Forces stand; upper body and extended arm hurtbox is anti-air invuln on frames 10-13; active frames 1-2 hit in front of Yasmine and are cancelable; active frames 3-6 hit above Yasmine with a solid anti-air hitbox (these frames can hit grounded opponents but are not cancelable); forward movement on startup can cause it to whiff against closer jump-ins; important combo tool with high hitstun and much more damage than 5HP when canceled; SA2 cancel: +20/+7

moves.name: 2LK A[L]
moves.notes: Chains into 5LP/2LP/2LK

moves.name: 2MK 2M
moves.notes: Solid cancelable low poke; can be hitconfirmed into a Target Combo extension for a knockdown (and an extended juggle with SA2 install active); SA2 cancel: +10/+5

moves.name: 2HK 3H
moves.notes: Sweep with good range that shifts Yasmine forward; has slight juggle potential without Drive Rush

moves.name: j.LP j.L
moves.notes: Quick air-to-air

moves.name: j.MP j.M
moves.notes: Puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; lower body projectile invuln 6-22f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: j.HP j.A[H]
moves.notes: Spikes airborne opponents on counter-hit/Punish Counter; hitbox starts at the bottom and expands upward throughout the first 3 active frames (decent air-to-air on later active frames); Yasmine's best vertical approach at closer ranges; lower body projectile invuln 9-23f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: j.LK j.A[L]
moves.notes: Cross-up; can be used as a fuzzy instant overhead (except vs. Blanka)

moves.name: j.MK j.A[M]
moves.notes: Cross-up; lower body projectile invuln 7-20f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: j.HK j.H
moves.notes: Yasmine's best horizontal approach with the longest range; lower body projectile invuln 10-19f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: 6MP 6M
moves.notes: Spike knockdown vs. airborne opponents; can link into light normals with meaty timing or with precise spacing in neutral; above average range for an overhead

moves.name: 4HK 4H
moves.notes: Hurtbox shifts backwards on frames 5-15 before attacking with a low-hitting sweep (can be used as an auto-shimmy tool to avoid throws and some short-range attacks to score a Punish Counter); 3f extra recovery on whiff; extends a hurtbox 1f before active that is vulnerable to projectiles; crouching state on frames 16-44 (standing state for the last frame on block or the last 4 frames on whiff); fully cancelable despite being a sweep; puts opponent into a limited juggle state (when canceled, combos into moves like 236LP/MP/PP, 623K, SA1/SA3); Punish Counter launches the opponent higher (cancels into 214HP/PP or 236HP, and gains corner juggles into 623K / SA1 without a cancel); Special/DI cancel is delayed until after active frames; SA2 cancel: KD+43/+6

moves.name: 5LP~LP 2L/A[L]~5L~5L
moves.notes: Important hitconfirm tool from light strings with more hitstun than other lights (can combo naturally into 236MP); 2f extra recovery on block; safe on block and becomes +1 vs. Burnout for continued pressure (5LP~LP > 214MP keeps her in 5LP range); 1f longer hitconfirm window into DR Cancel; 2f gap between hits on block; DR cancel is delayed until after 1st recovery frame; SA2 cancel: +5/+3

moves.name: 5MP~MP 5M~M
moves.notes: Easily hitconfirmable from 5MP starter (always a true blockstring from 5MP); puts opponents into a limited juggle state (combos into 236LP/MP/PP, 214PP, or Super); SA2 cancel: KD+43/+5

moves.name: 5MK~MK -
moves.notes: Always a true blockstring from 5MK starter; primarily used after a 5MK whiff punish as it's difficult to hitconfirm directly; very unsafe on hit or block (should always go into the ender even on block)

moves.name: 5MK~MK~HK -
moves.notes: 5f extra recovery on whiff/block; always a true blockstring from 5MK~MK; puts opponent into a limited juggle state on hit; becomes cancelable on hit only into 4KK (during SA2 install)

moves.name: 2MK~HK 2M~M
moves.notes: Hitconfirmable TC extension from low-hitting 2MK; always a true blockstring from 2MK; puts opponent into a limited juggle state on hit (much higher launch vs. airborne opponents, allowing follow-up juggles); becomes cancelable on hit only into 4KK (during SA2 install)

moves.name: LPLK LM
moves.notes: Has a corner throw loop with Dash + walk with enough time for a shimmy (throw requires 3f timing vs. standard characters, 4f timing vs. wide characters); Drive Rush gives better strike options in the corner (requires manual timing except for DR~6MP which sets up trade combos); can chase opponent midscreen with DR normals (not a true strike/throw mixup but can get into throw range if the opponent doesn't wake up with a fast attack); a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: 4LPLK 4LM
moves.notes: Side switch; after a corner back throw, can dash forward and poke with 2MK for a TC hitconfirm or 5HP for a potential trade combo; Drive Rush gives a pseudo-throw loop (and gives true strike/throw oki vs. Blanka / E. Honda / Zangief) but cannot get oki midscreen; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: HPHK DI
moves.notes: See Drive Impact . Airborne connect gives spinning juggle state on Punish Counter or corner Wall Splat with variable height.

moves.name: 6HPHK 6DI
moves.notes: Performed by inputting 6HPHK during blockstun; 5f extra recovery on hit; freezes the screen for 4f during startup; see Drive Reversal .

moves.name: 6HPHK 6DI
moves.notes: Performed by holding 6HPHK on wakeup; 5f extra recovery on hit; does not have any screen freeze except for a 12f freeze when interacting with the opponent's throw hitbox (this also refunds 1 Drive bar after punishing the throw); see Drive Reversal .

moves.name: MPMK DP
moves.notes: See Drive Parry . Perfect Parrying has only 1F of recovery and disables the opponent from canceling their attack. Perfect Parrying projectiles puts you into fixed 11 frames of recovery. After a Perfect Parry, all Super Gauge gain is reduced by 20% and Drive Gauge gain/damage is reduced by 50% for the entire punish combo.

moves.name: MPMK~66 DP~66
moves.notes: See Drive Rush ; 1-bar version performed out of a Parry; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation (if performed immediately after a successful Parry, only 1+8 startup); the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties; Distance: 0.708 (min/throw), 2.478 (min/block), 3.918 (max/final DR frame)

moves.name: MPMK or 66 DP or 66
moves.notes: See Drive Rush ; 3-bar version performed on hit/block from a cancelable normal; can also be performed on whiff from cancelable light normals; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation; the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties

moves.name: 236LP 236L
moves.notes: Shortest range but fastest startup (combos from all light normals and fast enough to juggle in situations where MP/HP versions are too slow); frame traps when canceled from 2LP or 5LK (nearly always punishable, but when spaced may avoid strong 6-frame punishes); leads to Alon follow-up that keeps opponent grounded (enhanced follow-up gives a knockdown); always a true blockstring when canceled into Alon follow-up; with Alon, this version deals more damage than MP Daloy with less combo scaling (can be more useful in short combo routes)

moves.name: 236MP 236M or 5S
moves.notes: Medium range and startup (combos from mediums and 5LP~LP TC); frame traps when canceled from 5LP~LP, 5MP~MP, or 2MK (always punishable at this range, but if spaced in neutral can be safe to some stronger 6-frame punishes); leads to Alon follow-up that knocks down with good midscreen oki (OTG bounce juggles possible from enhanced follow-up); always a true blockstring when canceled into Alon follow-up

moves.name: 236HP 236H
moves.notes: Longest range and slowest startup (combos from 2MP, 2HP, and 5HP); too slow to frame trap when canceled into without Burnout or Drive Rush starter (always punishable in cancels, but if spaced in neutral can be safe to some stronger 6-frame punishes); leads to Alon follow-up that launches the opponent upward for midscreen oki or corner juggles (stronger juggles possible on enhanced follow-up); always a true blockstring when canceled into Alon follow-up

moves.name: 236PP 236XX or A[5S]
moves.notes: Has the startup of the LP version with improved range and juggle potential for consistency; puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle OTG bounce state (ensures OD Alon follow-up connects); safe on block and +1 in Burnout for continued pressure; leads to solid damage and corner carry; canceling directly into SA2 on block causes high pushback for weak pressure (always better to cancel from Alon follow-up); the OD follow-up plays out a cinematic cutscene that can lead to juggles if SA2 canceled; always a true blockstring when canceled into Alon follow-up; SA2 cancel: +9/+8

moves.name: 236LP~6P 236L~6X
moves.notes: Final hit puts Yasmine into Bayani Mode on hit only (will not enter Bayani Mode if canceled on 3rd hit or if only the early hits connect); leaves grounded opponents at close range with slight advantage on hit for continued pressure; puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state (can only cancel into SA3); always a true blockstring from Daloy ng Tubig starter; active/recovery/total data refers to the block/whiff version without the final hit

moves.name: 236MP~6P 236M/5S~6X
moves.notes: Final hit puts Yasmine into Bayani Mode on hit only (will not enter Bayani Mode if canceled on 3rd hit or if only the early hits connect); slams the opponent to the ground and gives solid oki anywhere on the screen; puts opponents into a limited juggle state (can only cancel into SA3); always a true blockstring from Daloy ng Tubig starter; active/recovery/total data refers to the block/whiff version without the final hit

moves.name: 236HP~6P 236H~6X
moves.notes: Final hit puts Yasmine into Bayani Mode on hit only (will not enter Bayani Mode if canceled on 3rd hit or if only the early hits connect); launches the opponent upward into a limited juggle state (gives a corner juggle into 623LK or gives solid oki anywhere on the screen); launch height is not improved by juggling an airborne opponent; always a true blockstring from Daloy ng Tubig starter; active/recovery/total data refers to the block/whiff version without the final hit

moves.name: 236PP~6P 236XX/A[5S]~6X
moves.notes: Final cinematic hit puts Yasmine into Bayani Mode; does not cost any additional Drive gauge; puts opponents into a free juggle OTG Bounce state on hit or maintains the existing juggle state (requires SA2 cancel to continue the juggle, can combo into 214HP / DR normals / dash normals, will cause air reset if using a non-juggle move); always a true blockstring from OD Daloy ng Tubig starter; active/recovery/total data refers to block/whiff version without the final hit; SA2 cancel: KD+85/+3

moves.name: 236LP~6P 236L~6X
moves.notes: Spends the Bayani Mode enhancement; Yasmine performs the final hit on block unlike the standard version (safe on block and deals more Drive Damage); decent pressure tool vs. Burnout that deals more chip damage than the other versions (but opponent can walk back to avoid throws and prevent a 2LK chain from comboing); puts opponents into a limited juggle state (can only cancel into SA3 on grounded opponents, but in juggles like after 5MP~MP it can lead to a corner 623LK follow-up); grounded hit gives a KD +42 safe jump anywhere on the screen; always a true blockstring from Daloy ng Tubig starter; deals 0.1 bars of Drive Damage on a normal hit during SA2 Bayani Mode install

moves.name: 236MP~6P 236M/5S~6X
moves.notes: Spends the Bayani Mode enhancement; Yasmine performs the final hit on block unlike the standard version (safe on block and deals more Drive Damage); decent pressure tool vs. Burnout (but opponent can walk back to avoid throws and prevent a 2LK chain from comboing); puts opponents into a limited juggle OTG Bounce state (can juggle into 623MK/KK, but in juggles like after 5MP~MP it bounces higher for a juggle into 5HP / 623HK / SA1); grounded hit gives a KD +42 safe jump anywhere on the screen (but this sacrifices the juggle follow-up damage); always a true blockstring from Daloy ng Tubig starter; deals 0.1 bars of Drive Damage on a normal hit during SA2 Bayani Mode install

moves.name: 236HP~6P 236H~6X
moves.notes: Spends the Bayani Mode enhancement; 3f less recovery on block; Yasmine performs the final hit on block unlike the standard version (safe on block and deals more Drive Damage); decent pressure tool vs. Burnout (but opponent can walk back to avoid throws and prevent a 2LK chain from comboing); launches opponents high into a limited juggle state (much more rewarding than non-Bayani version, juggles into 5HP / DR~2HP / 623HK / Supers); always a true blockstring from Daloy ng Tubig starter; deals 0.1 bars of Drive Damage on a normal hit during SA2 Bayani Mode install

moves.name: 236PP~6P 236XX/A[5S]~6X
moves.notes: Exits Bayani Mode on block but maintains the enhancement on hit; does not cost any additional Drive gauge; properties change during SA2 install (+400 damage, Hard Knockdown with greater advantage, and deals 0.5 bars of Drive Damage on a normal hit); puts opponents into a free juggle OTG Bounce state on hit or maintains the existing juggle state (requires SA2 cancel to continue the juggle, can combo into 214HP / DR normals / dash normals, will cause air reset if using a non-juggle move); always a true blockstring from OD Daloy ng Tubig starter; active/recovery/total data refers to blocked version (final hit does not occur on whiff, like when 236PP punishes a Dhalsim limb); SA2 cancel: KD+85/+9

moves.name: 214LP 214L
moves.notes: Feints forward movement; useful to bait Parry / Drive Impact / jumps in neutral; hurtbox extends forward on frame 14 until the end of recovery; Yasmine is in a counter-hit state with a standing hurtbox for the entire duration

moves.name: 214MP 214M or 4S
moves.notes: Puts Yasmine into Bayani Mode on hit (this occurs after the hitstop of the 1st hit ends, so it will be granted when Super canceled but not if it trades with opponent's attack); safe on block advancing special; last 2 hits only play out on hit and are not cancelable (listed recovery refers to the blocked version); 3f extra recovery on whiff; 4f extra recovery when absorbed by armor (guaranteed punish when absorbed by Drive Impact unless canceled into SA3); counter-hit/Punish Counter bonus advantage carries through both hits (gives light confirms on CH and medium confirms on PC); puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state (follow-ups are usually only possible in the corner)

moves.name: 214HP 214H
moves.notes: Puts Yasmine into Bayani Mode on hit (this occurs after the hitstop of the 1st hit ends, so it will be granted when Super canceled but not if it trades with opponent's attack); plus on block advancing special; slow startup makes it reactable and only combos naturally from 2HP; last 2 hits only play out on hit and are not cancelable (listed recovery refers to the blocked/whiffed version); puts opponents into a limited juggle state (follow-ups only possible when juggled on airborne opponents)

moves.name: 214PP 214XX or A[4S]
moves.notes: Puts Yasmine into Bayani Mode on hit (this occurs after the hitstop of the 1st hit ends, so it will be granted when Super canceled but not if it trades with opponent's attack); last 2 hits only play out on hit and are not cancelable (listed recovery refers to the blocked/whiffed version); puts opponents into a limited juggle state; useful approach tool when buffered into SA2; SA2 cancel: +15/+5

moves.name: 236K 1S/2S/3S
moves.notes: Button strength determines trajectory (LK short, MK mid, HK far); cannot be steered manually after activation; follow-ups can be input starting on frame 24, and as late as frame 45 (236LK) / frame 42 (236MK) / frame 43 (236HK); can input OD follow-up with PP or KK for 2 Drive bars (safer on block); empty HK flip can have 1f longer or shorter aerial animation when crossing over the opponent at certain ranges; Yasmine is in a standing state with a standing-sized hurtbox during landing recovery

moves.name: 236KK A[2S]
moves.notes: Enhances the properties of follow-up attacks (improved hit and block advantage, can be input with no extra meter cost); can be steered by holding back/neutral/forward before the follow-up starts (no input gives the same trajectory as 236LK); gives more freedom to control Yasmine's trajectory compared to the meterless flip; follow-ups can be input on frames 24-46; Yasmine is in a standing state with a standing-sized hurtbox during landing recovery

moves.name: 236K~K 1S/2S/3S~5X
moves.notes: Button strength determines downward trajectory (LK short, MK mid, HK far); cannot hit cross-up; stalls mid-air to bait anti-airs; safe on block and links into light normals in almost all cases (worst advantage is only possible by inputting the follow-up right before landing against a point blank opponent); puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state

moves.name: 236KK~K or 236K~KK A[2S]~5X or 2S~5XX/A[5S]
moves.notes: Button strength determines downward trajectory (LK short, MK mid, HK far); can no longer alter the trajectory of OD Flip once the follow-up is activated; can be input with KK from a meterless Flip (button combination affects trajectory with LK+MK / LK+HK / MK+HK); cannot hit cross-up; stalls mid-air to bait anti-airs; plus on block and links into 5MP/2MP in almost all cases (worst advantage is only possible by inputting the follow-up right before landing against a point blank opponent); puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state

moves.name: 236K~P 1S/2S/3S~2X
moves.notes: Cross-up only (in very ambiguous situations, can actually be blocked either direction before landing behind the opponent); button strength determines downward trajectory (LP short / MP mid / HP far); can use KD +42 safe jump setups to auto-time the deepest possible hit midscreen (may not be possible if the opponent Back Rises); puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state (opponent falls toward Yasmine for easy follow-up)

moves.name: 236KK~P or 236K~PP A[2S]~2X or 2S~2XX/A[2S]
moves.notes: Cross-up only (in very ambiguous situations, can actually be blocked either direction before landing behind the opponent); button combination determines downward trajectory (LP+MP short / LP+HP mid / MP+HP far); can no longer alter the trajectory of OD Flip once the follow-up is activated; can use KD +42 safe jump setups to auto-time the deepest possible hit midscreen (may require OD Flip starter if the opponent Back Rises); puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state (opponent falls toward Yasmine for easy follow-up)

moves.name: 623LK 623L or 6S
moves.notes: Only the first 2 hits come out on block/whiff; cannot hit cross-up; best overall anti-air due to speed and invuln; very short horizontal range

moves.name: 623MK 623M
moves.notes: Only the first 2 hits come out on block/whiff; cannot hit cross-up; slightly more horizontal range than 623LK

moves.name: 623HK 623H
moves.notes: Only the first 2 hits come out on block/whiff; cannot hit cross-up; has the most horizontal range of meterless versions (works from max range 5LK cancel except in whiff punish scenarios)

moves.name: 623KK 623XX
moves.notes: Only the first 2 hits come out on block/whiff; cannot hit cross-up; Yasmine's primary reversal option; has the most horizontal range of all versions

moves.name: 22P 22X
