moves.notes: 2-hit boomerang projectile (can only hit once on the way up, then applies all remaining hits on the way back); button strength determines projectile distance (LP short / MP mid / HP far); the listed active frames are for the L/M/H versions respectively; projectile disappears if Yasmine is hit; can only have one boomerang on-screen at a time; only the first 3 active frames are Super cancelable; the initial upward hit keeps opponents grounded (less range vs. crouching opponents); the returning projectile puts opponents into a limited juggle state; canceling from 2HP gives increased hit advantage (use LP boomerang from point blank 2HP for a link into 2LP in the corner); projectile speed refers to the initial activation before changing directions

moves.name: 22PP 22XX
moves.notes: 3-hit boomerang projectile (can only hit once on the way up, then applies all remaining hits on the way back); button combination determines projectile distance (LP+MP short / LP+HP mid / MP+HP far); the listed active frames are for the L/M/H versions respectively; projectile disappears if Yasmine is hit; can only have one boomerang on-screen at a time; only the first 3 active frames are Super cancelable; the initial upward hit keeps opponents grounded (less range vs. crouching opponents); the returning projectile puts opponents into a limited juggle state; canceling from 2HP gives increased hit advantage (use LP+MP boomerang from point blank 2HP for a link into 5LK); projectile speed refers to the initial activation before changing directions; the 2nd hit Juggle Limit depends on whether the 1st hit connected on the way up (if returning projectile has all 3 hits: JL 2,2,10; if only 2 hits on the returning projectile, JL 2 followed by JL 10,10); SA2 cancel: +16/+12

moves.name: 236236K 236236L or 5/6HS
moves.notes: Puts Yasmine into Bayani Mode on hit; active frames 1-3 transition into a fully invincible cinematic on hit (1st hit can trade for 500 damage); active frames 4-6 perform a non-cinematic hit (1600 damage, KD +18~20 vs. grounded opponents, variable vs. airborne); fast reversal and a strong anti-air even at close ranges; useful juggle ender in any scenario where 623HK can also land

moves.name: 214214P 214214M or 4HS
moves.notes: Install that keeps Yasmine in Bayani Mode until the timer ends; timer lasts 1500 frames (25 seconds) and freezes during hitstop; cannot build additional Super gauge while the install is active; Yasmine stays in Bayani Mode after install ends (if 236P is activated with at least 1 frame left on the timer, the follow-up enhanced Alon can be used freely without spending the Bayani stock); grants access to a new special move Linya ng Liwanag (fast cross-up slash); changes the properties of OD Alon (new cinematic ender); each activation of an enhanced Bayani Mode special consumes 375f from the install timer (25%); install activation is useful for starting pressure from ranges approaches like 214PP or 236PP~6P (very high pushback and weak pressure when canceled directly from 5MP~MP or 236PP)

moves.name: 214214P~4KK 214214M/4HS~4MH
moves.notes: Requires SA2 install; each use consumes 375f (25%) of SA2 install timer; deals Drive Damage on normal hit (0.5 bars if both hits connect); reaches fullscreen and extends a huge proximity guard hitbox from frame 15 onward; if the 1st hit is blocked, parried, or absorbed by armor, Yasmine stops her forward movement and does not perform the 2nd hit (this hit has 2f active + 24f recovery); on hit, Yasmine will dash behind the opponent (even in the corner) and perform a 2nd hit that launches the opponent into a limited juggle state; this cross-up hit can also occur if the first hit whiffs (like in a knockdown setup or on a jumping opponent); cross-up hit has functionally 30f startup when used as an oki tool; can be canceled into from 2MK~HK and 5MK~MK~HK Target Combos on hit; active frame distribution is 2(11)5 when both hits connect; whiff recovery is 1f faster (19f) if Yasmine passes far behind the opponent before the 2nd hit comes out; startup time can be up to 3f faster (19f) if Yasmine passes through a close range airborne/teleporting opponent with no collision box; after a corner sideswitch, some follow-up juggles can whiff under the opponent (623HK requires delay, while 623MK and SA1 are auto-timed)

moves.name: 236236P 236236H or 2HS
moves.notes: Cinematic time regenerates ~2.2 Drive bars for Yasmine; can be used against projectiles from about round-start distance if it catches an extended hurtbox; tall hitbox can anti-air at long range but whiffs under close/mid range opponents; leaves Yasmine fullscreen on hit even if the opponent was cornered; can still get oki with Drive Rush into a delayed normal but cannot get into throw range; 2f startup when canceled from specials or 5HP

moves.name: 236236P 236236H or 2HS
moves.notes: Available at 25% HP or below; cinematic time regenerates ~2.3 Drive bars for Yasmine; can be used against projectiles from about round-start distance if it catches an extended hurtbox; tall hitbox can anti-air at long range but whiffs under close/mid range opponents; gives +1 oki after forward dash near the edge of throw range (opponent can back walk to avoid Throw or a chain after 2LK); can also Drive Rush for stronger pressure and bait 6f reversals with DR~2LP; 2f startup when canceled from specials or 5HP

moves.name: 5PPPKKK 5LMHS+DP+A
moves.notes: "I've been practicing this a lot! Gotcha! Cool, right?"; Yasmine attacks with a kick while catching the knife; gives a shorter knockdown on Punish Counter

moves.name: 5PPPKKK 5LMHS+DP+A
moves.notes: "I'm starving... Oh, I almost forgot! Aha! Want some? Really? Your loss! Alright, ready to go!"

moves.name: 6PPPKKK 6LMHS+DP+A
moves.notes: "Watch this! Haaaaaaaahhhhhh! Oh, um... hehehe..."

moves.name: 6[PPPKKK] 6[LMHS+DP+A]
moves.notes: "Watch this! Haaaaaaaahhhhhh! HADOKEN - Aaahhh! Wait, I did it? I gotta practice more!"; must be holding a button on frame 275 of startup to fill Yasmine with aura, causing her to perform a short-range stationary projectile attack

moves.name: 4PPPKKK 4LMHS+DP+A
moves.notes: "Hoy! You're not taking this seriously! Underestimate me and I'll make a big meanie face like this, then I'll walk all over you! Don't sandbag me!"
